# app/services/template_interpreter.py

from app.services.template_data import TEMPLATE_DATABASE

# 천간/지지 한자를 한글 독음으로 변환하는 매핑 딕셔너리
HANJA_TO_HANGUL = {
    "甲": "갑", "乙": "을", "丙": "병", "丁": "정", "戊": "무",
    "己": "기", "庚": "경", "辛": "신", "壬": "임", "癸": "계",
    "子": "자", "丑": "축", "寅": "인", "卯": "묘", "辰": "진", "巳": "사",
    "午": "오", "未": "미", "申": "신", "酉": "유", "戌": "술", "亥": "해",
}

_VALID_STEMS = set("甲乙丙丁戊己庚辛壬癸")
_VALID_BRANCHES = set("子丑寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥")


def format_pillar(pillar: str, lang: str) -> str:
    """언어 설정에 따라 간지 표기를 '한자 (한글)' 형태로 변환합니다 (한국어 기준)."""
    if not pillar:
        return ""
    if lang == "ko":
        hangul = "".join(HANJA_TO_HANGUL.get(char, char) for char in pillar)
        return f"{pillar} ({hangul})"
    return pillar


def _validate_saju_data(saju_data: dict) -> str:
    """최소한의 입력 검증. 검증된 day_pillar(2글자)를 반환."""
    if not isinstance(saju_data, dict):
        raise ValueError("saju_data must be an object.")

    day_pillar = saju_data.get("day_pillar")
    if not isinstance(day_pillar, str) or len(day_pillar) != 2:
        raise ValueError("saju_data.day_pillar must be a 2-character pillar string.")
    if day_pillar[0] not in _VALID_STEMS or day_pillar[1] not in _VALID_BRANCHES:
        raise ValueError(f"saju_data.day_pillar has invalid characters: {day_pillar!r}")

    ten_gods = saju_data.get("ten_gods")
    if ten_gods is not None and not isinstance(ten_gods, dict):
        raise ValueError("saju_data.ten_gods must be an object if provided.")

    return day_pillar


def generate_template_interpretation(saju_data: dict, lang: str = "en") -> dict:
    """계산된 사주 데이터를 바탕으로 템플릿 기반 해석 리포트를 조립합니다."""
    lang_pack = TEMPLATE_DATABASE.get(lang, TEMPLATE_DATABASE["en"])

    raw_day_pillar = _validate_saju_data(saju_data)
    day_pillar = format_pillar(raw_day_pillar, lang)

    ten_gods = saju_data.get("ten_gods") or {}
    luck_info = saju_data.get("luck_info")

    # 1. 일주 및 기질 성향 추출
    day_stem = raw_day_pillar[0]
    traits_dict = lang_pack.get("day_master_traits", {})
    default_trait = {
        "summary": "You possess a balanced inner rhythm.",
        "strengths": ["Balanced energy", "Adaptability"],
        "blind_spot": "Maintain consistency.",
    } if lang == "en" else {
        "summary": "조화롭고 균형 잡힌 내면의 리듬을 지니고 있습니다.",
        "strengths": ["균형 잡힌 에너지", "유연한 적응력"],
        "blind_spot": "꾸준한 템포 유지가 중요합니다.",
    }

    trait_data = traits_dict.get(day_stem, default_trait)

    # 십성 코드 수집
    found_codes = set()
    if isinstance(ten_gods, dict):
        for p_data in ten_gods.values():
            if isinstance(p_data, dict):
                for key in ("stem", "branch"):
                    code = p_data.get(key)
                    if code:
                        found_codes.add(code)

    # 2. 머니 플로우 조언 매핑
    wealth_advice_dict = lang_pack["wealth_section"]["advice"]
    wealth_code = "DEFAULT"
    for code in ("TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH", "TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH"):
        if code in found_codes:
            wealth_code = code
            break
    wealth_text = wealth_advice_dict.get(wealth_code, wealth_advice_dict["DEFAULT"])

    # 3. 커리어 성향 조언 매핑
    career_advice_dict = lang_pack["career_section"]["advice"]
    career_code = "DEFAULT"
    for code in ("TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD", "TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER", "TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER"):
        if code in found_codes:
            career_code = code
            break
    career_text = career_advice_dict.get(career_code, career_advice_dict["DEFAULT"])

    # 4. 대인관계 소통 방식 조언 매핑
    relation_advice_dict = lang_pack["relationship_section"]["advice"]
    relation_code = "DEFAULT"
    for code in ("TEN_GOD_FRIEND", "TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER"):
        if code in found_codes:
            relation_code = code
            break
    relation_text = relation_advice_dict.get(relation_code, relation_advice_dict["DEFAULT"])

    # 5. 웰니스 멘탈 케어 조언 매핑
    wellness_advice_dict = lang_pack["wellness_section"]["advice"]
    wellness_code = "DEFAULT"
    for code in ("TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS", "TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE"):
        if code in found_codes:
            wellness_code = code
            break
    wellness_text = wellness_advice_dict.get(wellness_code, wellness_advice_dict["DEFAULT"])

    # 6. 세운 및 성장 타이밍 조언 매핑
    luck_analysis_text = None
    target_year_for_title = None
    if isinstance(luck_info, dict):
        target_year = luck_info.get("target_year")   # ← 하드코딩 폴백 제거
        target_year_for_title = target_year
        annual_data = luck_info.get("annual_luck") or {}
        raw_annual_pillar = annual_data.get("pillar", "")
        annual_pillar = format_pillar(raw_annual_pillar, lang)
        annual_ten_god = (
            annual_data.get("annual_ten_god")
            or annual_data.get("ten_god", "")
        )

        if target_year is not None and raw_annual_pillar:
            base_annual_text = lang_pack["annual_luck_note"].format(
                target_year=target_year,
                annual_pillar=annual_pillar,
            )

            advice_dict = lang_pack.get("annual_luck_advice", {})
            default_advice = (
                "Focus on mindful growth and steady well-being." if lang == "en"
                else "마음의 성장과 꾸준한 웰니스 관리에 집중해 보세요."
            )
            advice_text = advice_dict.get(annual_ten_god, default_advice)
            luck_analysis_text = f"{base_annual_text} {advice_text}"

    # 최종 구조화된 리포트
    report_sections = {
        "title": lang_pack["title"],
        "intro": lang_pack["intro"],
        "core_blueprint": {
            "title": lang_pack["day_master_intro"].format(day_pillar=day_pillar),
            "details": trait_data,
        },
        "wealth_flow": {
            "title": lang_pack["wealth_section"]["title"],
            "description": lang_pack["wealth_section"]["description"],
            "advice": wealth_text,
        },
        "career_architecture": {
            "title": lang_pack["career_section"]["title"],
            "description": lang_pack["career_section"]["description"],
            "advice": career_text,
        },
        "relationship_dynamics": {
            "title": lang_pack["relationship_section"]["title"],
            "description": lang_pack["relationship_section"]["description"],
            "advice": relation_text,
        },
        "wellness_care": {
            "title": lang_pack["wellness_section"]["title"],
            "description": lang_pack["wellness_section"]["description"],
            "advice": wellness_text,
        },
        "strategic_timing": {
            "title": lang_pack["annual_luck_title"].format(
                target_year=(
                    target_year_for_title
                    if target_year_for_title is not None
                    else "—"
                )
            ),
            "analysis": luck_analysis_text,
        },
        "disclaimer": lang_pack["disclaimer"],
    }

    return report_sections

=== FILE: app/services/variation.py ===
"""
Seed 기반 결정론적 변형 선택 엔진 (Step 3).

목적: 동일한 semantic 결과가 유저/날짜/스코프별로 자연스럽게 다른 표현을 갖도록.

원칙:
  - 프로세스 간 결정론 (sha256 사용, Python hash() 사용 금지)
  - user_id > birth_date > "anonymous" 우선순위
  - 변형 리스트가 비어있으면 예외
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from typing import Any, Sequence


def _stable_hash(*parts: Any) -> int:
    """프로세스 간 안정적인 해시 (Python hash()는 seed 랜덤)."""
    payload = "|".join(str(p) for p in parts if p is not None)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(payload.encode("utf-8")).digest()
    return int.from_bytes(digest[:8], "big")


def pick_variant(
    variants: Sequence[Any],
    *,
    seed_parts: Sequence[Any],
) -> Any:
    """
    seed_parts로부터 결정론적으로 variants 중 하나를 반환.

    - 같은 seed_parts → 같은 결과 (프로세스 간에도 동일)
    - variants 비어있으면 ValueError
    """
    if not variants:
        raise ValueError("variants must not be empty")
    idx = _stable_hash(*seed_parts) % len(variants)
    return variants[idx]


def make_seed(
    *,
    user_id: str | None,
    birth_date: str | None,
    scope: str,
    discriminator: str,
) -> tuple:
    """
    표준 시드 튜플 생성.

    Args:
        user_id: 인증된 유저 ID (없으면 None)
        birth_date: YYYY-MM-DD (없으면 None)
        scope: "daily" / "monthly" / "year" 등 콘텐츠 스코프
        discriminator: 날짜, 월 인덱스, 테마 키 등 스코프 내 구분자
    """
    anchor = user_id or birth_date or "anonymous"
    return (anchor, scope, discriminator)

"""
app/services/visual_generator.py

유저의 사주 프로필을 기반으로 3D 아트워크 배경화면 URL을 생성합니다.
- 오행(Dominant Element) + 십성(Work Mode) 조합
"""
import os
from urllib.parse import urljoin

# 오행 시그니처 -> 파일명 접두어
ELEMENT_MAP = {
    "GROWTH": "wood",
    "SPARK": "fire",
    "GROUND": "earth",
    "EDGE": "metal",
    "FLOW": "water"
}

# 십성 모드 -> 파일명 접미어
MODE_MAP = {
    "THE_CREATOR": "creator",
    "THE_CHALLENGER": "challenger",
    "THE_OFFICER": "officer",
    "THE_SURVIVOR": "survivor",
    "THE_MYSTIC": "mystic",
    "THE_MENTOR": "mentor",
    "THE_GENERALIST": "generalist",
    "THE_STEWARD": "steward",
    "THE_OPERATOR": "operator",
    "THE_FLOW": "flow"
}

def get_daily_wallpaper_url(profile: dict) -> str:
    """
    유저의 프로필을 받아 매핑된 3D 아트워크 이미지 URL을 반환합니다.
    """
    # 1. 주 오행 추출 (없으면 FLOW 기본값)
    dominant = profile.get("energy_signature", {}).get("dominant", [])
    elem_sig = dominant[0] if dominant else "FLOW"
    elem_str = ELEMENT_MAP.get(elem_sig, "water")

    # 2. 주 행동 모드 추출 (없으면 THE_GENERALIST 기본값)
    work_mode = profile.get("work_mode", "THE_GENERALIST")
    mode_str = "generalist"  # 임시: 5장 테스트를 위해 고정

    # 3. 파일명 조합 (예: bg_wood_creator.webp)
    filename = f"bg_{elem_str}_{mode_str}.webp"

    # 4. CDN/Supabase URL 반환 (환경변수로 설정 가능)
    base_url = os.environ.get("SAJU_ASSET_BASE_URL", "https://mock-cdn.vectorlabs.app/wallpapers/")
    if not base_url.endswith("/"):
        base_url += "/"
    
    return urljoin(base_url, filename)

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ActivityIndicator, Switch } from "react-native";
import DateTimePicker, { DateTimePickerEvent } from "@react-native-community/datetimepicker";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import { colors, spacing, radius } from "@/theme";

import { TimezonePickerModal } from "@/components/TimezonePickerModal";
import { CITY_LIST } from "@/constants/cities";
import { TIMEZONE_LIST } from "@/constants/timezones";

export default function CompatibilityScreen() {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const myProfile = useProfileStore((s) => s.profile);

  const [relationshipType, setRelationshipType] = useState<"romance" | "business" | "friend" | "family">("romance");

  const [partnerDate, setPartnerDate] = useState(new Date(1995, 9, 24));
  const [showDatePicker, setShowDatePicker] = useState(false);
  const [partnerTime, setPartnerTime] = useState(new Date(2000, 0, 1, 12, 0));
  const [showTimePicker, setShowTimePicker] = useState(false);
  const [unknownTime, setUnknownTime] = useState(true);
  
  const [city, setCity] = useState("seoul");
  const [showCityModal, setShowCityModal] = useState(false);
  const [gender, setGender] = useState("F");

  const [isCustomCity, setIsCustomCity] = useState(false);
  const [customTimezone, setCustomTimezone] = useState("Asia/Seoul");
  const [showTimezoneModal, setShowTimezoneModal] = useState(false);

  const [isCalculated, setIsCalculated] = useState(false);
  const cityLabel = isCustomCity ? "직접 입력" : (CITY_LIST.find(c => c.key === city)?.label || "서울 (Seoul)");
  const tzLabel = TIMEZONE_LIST.find(t => t.key === customTimezone)?.label || customTimezone;

  const onSelectCity = (key: string) => {
    if (key === CUSTOM_CITY_KEY) {
      setIsCustomCity(true);
    } else {
      setIsCustomCity(false);
      setCity(key);
    }
  };

  const onChangeDate = (event: DateTimePickerEvent, date?: Date) => {
    setShowDatePicker(false);
    if (event.type === "set" && date) setPartnerDate(date);
  };

  const onChangeTime = (event: DateTimePickerEvent, time?: Date) => {
    setShowTimePicker(false);
    if (event.type === "set" && time) setPartnerTime(time);
  };

  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["compatibility", relationshipType],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!myProfile) throw new Error("내 사주 정보가 없습니다. 홈에서 먼저 입력해주세요.");

      const yyyy = partnerDate.getFullYear();
      const mm = String(partnerDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
      const dd = String(partnerDate.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
      const timeMode = unknownTime ? "noon" : "exact";
      let timeString = null;
      if (!unknownTime) {
        const hh = String(partnerTime.getHours()).padStart(2, "0");
        const min = String(partnerTime.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
        timeString = `${hh}:${min}:00`;
      }

      const offsetHours = new Date().getTimezoneOffset() / -60; 
      const fallbackLongitude = offsetHours * 15;

      return api.compatibility({
        person_a: myProfile,
        person_b: {
          birth_date: `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`,
          birth_time: timeString,
          birth_time_mode: timeMode,
          birth_location: isCustomCity ? null : city,
          timezone_str: isCustomCity ? customTimezone : "Asia/Seoul",
          longitude: isCustomCity ? fallbackLongitude : 126.978,
          gender: gender as "M" | "F",
        },
        relationship_type: relationshipType,
        lang: "ko",
      });

    enabled: false,
  });

    if (!myProfile) return;
    setIsCalculated(true);
    await refetch();
  };

    if (isLoading) return <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={colors.primary} style={{ marginTop: 20 }} />;
    if (error) {
      const msg = error instanceof ApiError ? error.detail : (error as Error).message;
      return <Text style={{ color: colors.danger, marginTop: 20, textAlign: "center" }}>{msg}</Text>;
    }
    if (!data?.compatibility) return null;
    const compat = data.compatibility;

    const rawScore = compat.overall.score;
    const displayScore = Math.round((rawScore + 1) * 50);
    
    const gradeColors: Record<string, string> = { PEAK: "#2F7A3F", FAVORABLE: "#5FAF7A", NEUTRAL: "#7A6A5C", CAUTION: "#D4A017", CHALLENGING: "#C2461F" };
    const color = gradeColors[compat.overall.grade] || colors.text;

    return (
      <View style={{ marginTop: 30, gap: 16 }}>
        <View style={styles.resultCard}>
          <Text style={styles.resultLabel}>
            {relationshipType === "romance" ? "연애 케미" : 
             relationshipType === "business" ? "비즈니스 케미" : 
             relationshipType === "friend" ? "친구 케미" : "가족 케미"}
          </Text>
          
          {/* 👇 100점 만점 점수 표시 및 게이지 바 */}
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "flex-end", marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <Text style={[styles.overallScore, { color }]}>{displayScore}</Text>

        </View>

        <View style={[styles.segmentWrap, { paddingRight: 0 }]}>
          {[
            { key: "romance", label: "💖 연애" },
            { key: "business", label: "💼 비즈니스" },
            { key: "friend", label: "🤝 친구" },
            { key: "family", label: "🏠 가족" },
          ].map((t) => (

        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.genderBtn, gender === "M" && styles.genderBtnActive]} onPress={() => setGender("M")}>
          <Text style={[styles.genderText, gender === "M" && styles.genderTextActive]}>남성</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.genderBtn, gender === "F" && styles.genderBtnActive]} onPress={() => setGender("F")}>
          <Text style={[styles.genderText, gender === "F" && styles.genderTextActive]}>여성</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity
        style={[styles.nextBtn, !myProfile && { opacity: 0.4 }]}
        onPress={handleCalculate}
        disabled={!myProfile}
      >
        <Text style={styles.nextBtnText}>케미 보기</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>

      {isCalculated && renderResult()}

      <CityPickerModal visible={showCityModal} onClose={() => setShowCityModal(false)} onSelect={onSelectCity} currentCityKey={isCustomCity ? CUSTOM_CITY_KEY : city} />
      <TimezonePickerModal visible={showTimezoneModal} onClose={() => setShowTimezoneModal(false)} onSelect={setCustomTimezone} currentTz={customTimezone} />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

﻿import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { View, Text, ScrollView, ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity } from "react-native";
import { router } from "expo-router";

import { api, ApiError } from "@/api/client";
import { colors, spacing, radius } from "@/theme";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/store/authStore";
import type { DailyResponse } from "../../types";

export default function DailyScreen() {
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<any>(null);
  const [profileLoaded, setProfileLoaded] = useState(false);
  
  // 👇 유저 정보(토큰 상태)를 가져옵니다.
  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user);
  const ready = useAuthStore((s) => s.ready);

  useEffect(() => {
    AsyncStorage.getItem("saju_profile").then((data) => {
      if (data) setProfile(JSON.parse(data));
      setProfileLoaded(true);
    });
  }, []);

  const { data, isLoading, error } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["daily", profile, user?.id], // 👈 user.id를 키에 추가하여 로그인 상태 변경 시 재호출
    // user와 ready 상태가 확실할 때만 API 호출
    queryFn: () => api.daily({ ...profile, days: 7, lang: "ko" }),
    enabled: !!profile && profileLoaded && !!user && ready, 
    retry: false,
  });

  if (!profileLoaded || !ready) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={colors.primary} />
        <Text style={styles.loadingText}>사용자 정보를 불러오는 중...</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!profile) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <Text style={styles.errorText}>사주 정보가 없습니다.</Text>
        <Text style={styles.errorDetail}>홈 탭에서 사주 정보를 먼저 입력해 주세요.</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={colors.primary} />
        <Text style={styles.loadingText}>7일간의 기운을 읽어오고 있습니다...</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    const isForbidden = error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 403;
    if (isForbidden) {
      return (
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <View style={{ backgroundColor: colors.surface, padding: 24, borderRadius: radius.lg, alignItems: "center", borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.border }}>
            <Ionicons name="lock-closed" size={48} color={colors.primary} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }} />
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: "700", color: colors.text, marginBottom: 8 }}>구독자 전용 기능입니다</Text>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 15, color: colors.textMuted, textAlign: "center", lineHeight: 22, marginBottom: 24 }}>
              매일 아침 당신의 기운을 읽어주는\n데일리 에너지 서비스입니다.\n프리미엄으로 업그레이드하고\n7일치 흐름을 미리 확인하세요.
            </Text>
            <TouchableOpacity style={{ backgroundColor: colors.primary, paddingHorizontal: 24, paddingVertical: 14, borderRadius: radius.md, width: "100%", alignItems: "center" }} onPress={() => router.push("/(tabs)/settings")}>
              <Text style={{ color: "#FFF", fontSize: 16, fontWeight: "700" }}>프리미엄 업그레이드</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      );
    }
    return (
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <Text style={styles.errorText}>오류가 발생했습니다</Text>
        <Text style={styles.errorDetail}>{(error as Error).message}</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  const dailyData = data?.daily as DailyResponse["daily"];
  if (!dailyData || !dailyData.items) return null;

  const gradeColors: Record<string, string> = {
    PEAK: "#2F7A3F",
    FAVORABLE: "#5FAF7A",
    NEUTRAL: "#7A6A5C",
    CAUTION: "#D4A017",
    CHALLENGING: "#C2461F",
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 100 }}>
      <View style={styles.heroBox}>
        <Text style={styles.heroTitle}>{dailyData.hero}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.heroSub}>앞으로 7일간의 일운입니다.</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.list}>
        {dailyData.items.map((item, idx) => (
          <View key={idx} style={styles.card}>
            <View style={styles.cardHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.dateText}>{item.date}</Text>
              <View style={[styles.badge, { backgroundColor: gradeColors[item.grade] + "20" }]}>
                <Text style={[styles.badgeText, { color: gradeColors[item.grade] }]}>
                  {item.grade_label}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
            
            <Text style={styles.dayName}>{item.name}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.headline}>{item.headline}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.body}>{item.body}</Text>
            
            <View style={styles.tipBox}>
              <Text style={styles.tipText}>💡 <Text style={{fontWeight: "700"}}>집중:</Text> {item.lean_into}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.tipText}>⚠️ <Text style={{fontWeight: "700"}}>주의:</Text> {item.watch_for}</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

export default function HomeScreen() {

  const profileReady = useProfileStore((s) => s.ready);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({ core: true });

    if (profileReady && !profile) {
      router.replace("/birth-input");
    }

    queryFn: () => api.report({ ...profile, target_year: new Date().getFullYear(), lang: "ko" }),
    enabled: !!profile,
    retry: false,
  });

    setExpanded(prev => ({ ...prev, [id]: !prev[id] }));

  };

  if (!profileReady || !profile) return <View style={styles.center}><ActivityIndicator color={colors.primary} /></View>;

                    </View>
                  ))}

                  {/* Monthly */}
                  {key === "monthly" && sec.items && sec.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (

                      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 4 }}>
                        <Text style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: "700", color: colors.text }}>{item.approx_solar_month} ({item.pillar})</Text>
                        <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: colors.primary }}>{item.grade_label}</Text>

                      <Text style={styles.paragraph}>{item.headline}</Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}

                                    {/* Dynamic Sections (Love, Career, Wealth, Money, Work, Bonds) */}
                  {sec.patterns && sec.patterns.length > 0 && (
                    <View style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                      <Text style={styles.blockTitle}>관계 패턴</Text>
                      {sec.patterns.map((p: string, i: number) => (
                        <Text key={i} style={styles.paragraph}>• {p}</Text>
                      ))}

                  )}
                  {sec.compatibility && (
                    <View style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: 12, backgroundColor: colors.surface, borderRadius: radius.md }}>
                      <Text style={styles.blockTitle}>궁합</Text>
                      <Text style={styles.paragraph}>최고의 궁합: {(sec.compatibility.best_match || []).join(", ")}</Text>

                      <Text style={styles.paragraph}>주의할 궁합: {(sec.compatibility.challenging_match || []).join(", ")}</Text>
                      <Text style={{ fontSize: 14, color: colors.textMuted }}>{sec.compatibility.challenging_reason}</Text>
                    </View>
                  )}
                  {sec.actions && sec.actions.length > 0 && (
                    <View style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                      <Text style={styles.blockTitle}>실천 가이드</Text>
                      {sec.actions.map((a: string, i: number) => (
                        <Text key={i} style={styles.paragraph}>→ {a}</Text>
                      ))}
                    </View>
                  )}
                  {sec.red_flags && sec.red_flags.length > 0 && (
                    <View style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: 12, backgroundColor: "#FFF5F0", borderRadius: radius.md }}>
                      <Text style={[styles.blockTitle, { color: "#C2461F" }]}>주의할 점</Text>
                      {sec.red_flags.map((r: string, i: number) => (
                        <Text key={i} style={styles.paragraph}>⚠ {r}</Text>
                      ))}
                    </View>
                  )}
                  {!sec.patterns && isLocked && (
                    <View style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: 16, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderRadius: radius.md, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.border }}>
                      <Text style={{ fontSize: 15, color: colors.textMuted, textAlign: "center", lineHeight: 22 }}>
                        프리미엄 결제 후 상세 분석을 확인하실 수 있습니다.
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  )}

                  {/* 공통 잠금 힌트 */}
                  {isLocked && <LockedHint onPress={goToUpgrade} />}

                </View>
              )}
            </View>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.disclaimerBox}>
        <Text style={styles.disclaimerText}>{report.disclaimer}</Text>
      </View>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, Alert, Platform } from "react-native";
import { router } from "expo-router";
import { colors, spacing, radius } from "@/theme";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/store/authStore";
import { useProfileStore } from "@/store/profileStore";
import { api } from "@/api/client";
import { SocialLoginModal } from "@/components/SocialLoginModal";
import { PaymentModal } from "@/components/PaymentModal";

export default function SettingsScreen() {
  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user);
  const signOut = useAuthStore((s) => s.signOut);
  const clearProfile = useProfileStore((s) => s.clearProfile);

  const [showLogin, setShowLogin] = useState(false);
  const [showPayment, setShowPayment] = useState(false);

  const handleUpgrade = () => {
    if (!user) return;
    if (user.is_anonymous) {
      setShowLogin(true);
    } else {
      setShowPayment(true);
    }
  };

  const handleReset = async () => {
    await clearProfile();
    router.replace("/birth-input");
  };

  const handleDeleteAccount = () => {
    const performDelete = async () => {
      try {
        await api.deleteAccount();
        await clearProfile();
        await signOut();
        router.replace("/");
      } catch (e: any) {
        const msg = e?.detail || "계정 삭제에 실패했습니다.";
        if (Platform.OS === "web") alert(msg);
        else Alert.alert("오류", msg);
      }
    };

    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
      if (confirm("정말로 계정을 삭제하시겠습니까? 모든 데이터가 사라집니다.")) performDelete();
    } else {
      Alert.alert("계정 삭제", "정말로 계정을 영구 삭제하시겠습니까? 이 작업은 되돌릴 수 없습니다.", [
        { text: "취소", style: "cancel" },
        { text: "영구 삭제", style: "destructive", onPress: performDelete },
      ]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.profileBox}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>내 계정 정보</Text>
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <Text style={styles.label}>이용 등급</Text>
          <Text style={styles.value}>{user?.tier.toUpperCase()}</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <Text style={styles.label}>사용자 ID</Text>
          <Text style={styles.value}>{user?.id.slice(0, 8)}...</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      {user?.tier === "free" && (
        <View style={[styles.profileBox, { backgroundColor: colors.primary + "10", borderColor: colors.primary }]}>
          <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: colors.primary }]}>✨ 프리미엄 업그레이드</Text>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 14, color: colors.text, marginBottom: 12, lineHeight: 20 }}>
            구독하면 7일치 데일리 에너지와 궁합 분석을 모두 이용할 수 있습니다.
          </Text>
          <TouchableOpacity style={{ backgroundColor: colors.primary, padding: 14, borderRadius: radius.md, alignItems: "center" }} onPress={handleUpgrade}>
            <Text style={{ color: "#FFF", fontSize: 16, fontWeight: "700" }}>프리미엄 구독하기</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      )}

      <View style={styles.list}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.btn} onPress={handleReset}>
          <Text style={styles.btnText}>출생 정보 수정하기</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        
        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.btn, styles.dangerBtn]} onPress={handleDeleteAccount}>
          <Text style={styles.dangerText}>계정 영구 삭제</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <SocialLoginModal
        visible={showLogin}
        onClose={() => setShowLogin(false)}
        onSuccess={() => {
          setShowLogin(false);
          setShowPayment(true);
        }}
      />
      <PaymentModal
        visible={showPayment}
        onClose={() => setShowPayment(false)}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.bg, padding: spacing.lg },
  profileBox: { backgroundColor: colors.surface, padding: spacing.md, borderRadius: radius.md, marginBottom: spacing.xl, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.border },
  sectionTitle: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: "700", color: colors.text, marginBottom: spacing.md },
  row: { flexDirection: "row", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: spacing.sm },
  label: { fontSize: 15, color: colors.textMuted },
  value: { fontSize: 15, fontWeight: "600", color: colors.text },
  list: { gap: spacing.sm },
  btn: { backgroundColor: colors.surface, padding: spacing.md, borderRadius: radius.md, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.border, alignItems: "center" },
  btnText: { color: colors.text, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: "600" },
  dangerBtn: { borderColor: colors.danger },
  dangerText: { color: colors.danger, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: "600" },
});

﻿import { useEffect } from "react";
import { Stack } from "expo-router";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { SafeAreaProvider } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import { StatusBar } from "expo-status-bar";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/store/authStore";
import { useProfileStore } from "@/store/profileStore";

const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: { queries: { staleTime: 60_000, retry: 1 } },
});

export default function RootLayout() {
  const bootstrap = useAuthStore((s) => s.bootstrap);
  const loadProfile = useProfileStore((s) => s.loadProfile);

  useEffect(() => {
    bootstrap();
    loadProfile();
  }, [bootstrap, loadProfile]);

  return (
    <SafeAreaProvider>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <StatusBar style="dark" />
        <Stack screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }}>
          <Stack.Screen name="index" />
          <Stack.Screen name="birth-input" options={{ title: "출생 정보 입력", headerShown: true }} />
          <Stack.Screen name="(tabs)" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
        </Stack>
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </SafeAreaProvider>
  );
}

﻿import { useState } from "react";
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Switch, Alert } from "react-native";
import { router } from "expo-router";
import DateTimePicker, { DateTimePickerEvent } from "@react-native-community/datetimepicker";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import { useProfileStore } from "@/store/profileStore";
import { CityPickerModal, CUSTOM_CITY_KEY } from "@/components/CityPickerModal";
import { TimezonePickerModal } from "@/components/TimezonePickerModal"; // 👈 추가
import { CITY_LIST } from "@/constants/cities";
import { TIMEZONE_LIST } from "@/constants/timezones";
import { colors } from "@/theme";

export default function BirthInput() {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const saveProfile = useProfileStore((s) => s.saveProfile);
  
  const [birthDate, setBirthDate] = useState(new Date(1990, 0, 1));
  const [showDatePicker, setShowDatePicker] = useState(false);
  const [birthTime, setBirthTime] = useState(new Date(2000, 0, 1, 12, 0));
  const [showTimePicker, setShowTimePicker] = useState(false);
  const [unknownTime, setUnknownTime] = useState(false);
  
  const [city, setCity] = useState("seoul");
  const [showCityModal, setShowCityModal] = useState(false);
  const [gender, setGender] = useState("M");

  const [isCustomCity, setIsCustomCity] = useState(false);
  const [customTimezone, setCustomTimezone] = useState("Asia/Seoul");
  const [showTimezoneModal, setShowTimezoneModal] = useState(false); // 👈 타임존 모달 상태

  const cityLabel = isCustomCity ? "직접 입력" : (CITY_LIST.find(c => c.key === city)?.label || "서울 (Seoul)");
  const tzLabel = TIMEZONE_LIST.find(t => t.key === customTimezone)?.label || customTimezone;

  const onSelectCity = (key: string) => {
    if (key === CUSTOM_CITY_KEY) {
      setIsCustomCity(true);
    } else {
      setIsCustomCity(false);
      setCity(key);
    }
  };

  const onChangeDate = (event: DateTimePickerEvent, date?: Date) => {
    setShowDatePicker(false);
    if (event.type === "set" && date) setBirthDate(date);
  };

  const onChangeTime = (event: DateTimePickerEvent, time?: Date) => {
    setShowTimePicker(false);
    if (event.type === "set" && time) setBirthTime(time);
  };

  const handleNext = async () => {
    try {
      const yyyy = birthDate.getFullYear();
      const mm = String(birthDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
      const dd = String(birthDate.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
      const timeMode = unknownTime ? "noon" : "exact";
      let timeString = null;
      if (!unknownTime) {
        const hh = String(birthTime.getHours()).padStart(2, "0");
        const min = String(birthTime.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
        timeString = `${hh}:${min}:00`;
      }
      
      const offsetHours = new Date().getTimezoneOffset() / -60; 
      const fallbackLongitude = offsetHours * 15;

      const profile = {
        birth_date: `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`,
        birth_time: timeString,
        birth_time_mode: timeMode,
        birth_location: isCustomCity ? null : city,
        timezone_str: isCustomCity ? customTimezone : "Asia/Seoul",
        longitude: isCustomCity ? fallbackLongitude : 126.978,
        gender: gender,
      };
      
      await saveProfile(profile);
      router.replace("/(tabs)/home");
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert("오류", "저장에 실패했습니다. 입력값을 확인해주세요.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <ScrollView style={styles.container} contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: insets.bottom + 24 }}>
      <Text style={styles.title}>출생 정보 입력</Text>
      
      <Text style={styles.label}>생년월일</Text>
      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.inputBtn} onPress={() => setShowDatePicker(true)}>
        <Text style={styles.inputText}>{birthDate.getFullYear()}년 {birthDate.getMonth() + 1}월 {birthDate.getDate()}일</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
      {showDatePicker && <DateTimePicker value={birthDate} mode="date" display="spinner" onChange={onChangeDate} />}

      <View style={styles.rowBetween}>
        <Text style={styles.label}>출생 시간</Text>
        <View style={styles.switchWrap}>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#7A6A5C", marginRight: 6 }}>시간을 몰라요</Text>
          <Switch value={unknownTime} onValueChange={setUnknownTime} trackColor={{ false: "#EADFCF", true: "#E85D2F" }} />
        </View>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.inputBtn, unknownTime && { opacity: 0.4 }]} onPress={() => { if(!unknownTime) setShowTimePicker(true); }} disabled={unknownTime}>
        <Text style={styles.inputText}>
          {unknownTime ? "시간 모름 (정오 기준)" : `${String(birthTime.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}시 ${String(birthTime.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}분`}
        </Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
      {showTimePicker && <DateTimePicker value={birthTime} mode="time" display="spinner" onChange={onChangeTime} />}

      <Text style={styles.label}>출생지</Text>
      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.inputBtn} onPress={() => setShowCityModal(true)}>
        <Text style={styles.inputText}>{cityLabel}</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>

      {isCustomCity && (
        <View style={styles.customBox}>
          <Text style={styles.label}>출생지 타임존 (Timezone)</Text>
          {/* 👇 텍스트 입력 대신 터치하면 타임존 선택 모달이 뜨도록 변경 */}
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.textInput} onPress={() => setShowTimezoneModal(true)}>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 15, color: colors.text }}>{tzLabel}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: colors.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>
            * 정확한 경도는 시스템이 타임존을 기준으로 자동 계산합니다.
          </Text>
        </View>
      )}

      <Text style={styles.label}>성별</Text>
      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 10, marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.genderBtn, gender === "M" && styles.genderBtnActive]} onPress={() => setGender("M")}>
          <Text style={[styles.genderText, gender === "M" && styles.genderTextActive]}>남성</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.genderBtn, gender === "F" && styles.genderBtnActive]} onPress={() => setGender("F")}>
          <Text style={[styles.genderText, gender === "F" && styles.genderTextActive]}>여성</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.nextBtn} onPress={handleNext}>
        <Text style={styles.nextBtnText}>결과 보기</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>

      <CityPickerModal visible={showCityModal} onClose={() => setShowCityModal(false)} onSelect={onSelectCity} currentCityKey={isCustomCity ? CUSTOM_CITY_KEY : city} />
      <TimezonePickerModal visible={showTimezoneModal} onClose={() => setShowTimezoneModal(false)} onSelect={setCustomTimezone} currentTz={customTimezone} />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: "#FDF6EE", padding: 20 },
  title: { fontSize: 22, fontWeight: "700", color: "#2B1B12", marginBottom: 20, marginTop: 10 },
  label: { fontSize: 15, fontWeight: "600", color: "#7A6A5C", marginBottom: 6 },
  rowBetween: { flexDirection: "row", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 6 },
  switchWrap: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center" },
  inputBtn: { backgroundColor: "#FFF", padding: 14, borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: "#EADFCF", marginBottom: 16 },
  inputText: { fontSize: 15, color: "#2B1B12" },
  customBox: { backgroundColor: "#FFF", padding: 14, borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: "#EADFCF", marginBottom: 16, marginTop: -8 },
  textInput: { backgroundColor: "#FDF6EE", padding: 10, borderRadius: 8, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: "#EADFCF", justifyContent: "center", minHeight: 40 },
  genderBtn: { flex: 1, padding: 14, borderRadius: 12, backgroundColor: "#FFF", borderWidth: 1, borderColor: "#EADFCF", alignItems: "center" },
  genderBtnActive: { backgroundColor: "#E85D2F", borderColor: "#E85D2F" },
  genderText: { fontSize: 15, color: "#7A6A5C" },
  genderTextActive: { color: "#FFF", fontWeight: "600" },

﻿import { useEffect } from "react";
import { ActivityIndicator, View, Text } from "react-native";
import { router } from "expo-router";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/store/authStore";
import { useProfileStore } from "@/store/profileStore";

export default function Index() {
  const ready = useAuthStore((s) => s.ready);
  const profileReady = useProfileStore((s) => s.ready);
  const profile = useProfileStore((s) => s.profile);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready || !profileReady) return;
    router.replace(profile ? "/(tabs)/home" : "/birth-input");
  }, [ready, profileReady, profile]);

  return (
    <View style={{ flex: 1, justifyContent: "center", alignItems: "center", backgroundColor: "#FDF6EE" }}>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 36, fontWeight: "800", color: "#E85D2F", marginBottom: 8, letterSpacing: 1 }}>Gyeol</Text>
      <ActivityIndicator color="#E85D2F" />

=== FILE: frontend/src/api/client.ts ===
﻿import type {
  AuthResponse,
  SajuRequest,
  SajuResponse,
  ReportRequest,
  ReportResponse,
  DailyResponse,
  CompatibilityRequest,
  CompatibilityResponse,
  PushTokenRequest,
} from "../../types";

// Cloud Run 백엔드 주소로 변경
const BASE_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL ?? "https://vector-labs-api-787049663118.asia-northeast3.run.app/api/v1";

export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(public status: number, public detail: string) {
    super(detail);
    this.name = "ApiError";
  }
}

let _token: string | null = null;
export function setAuthToken(t: string | null) {
  _token = t;
}

async function request<T>(path: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    ...(init.headers as Record<string, string> | undefined),
  };
  if (_token) headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${_token}`;

  // 10초 타임아웃 설정
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 30000);

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, {
      ...init,
      headers,
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);

    if (res.status === 204) return undefined as T;

    const text = await res.text();
    const body = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;

    if (!res.ok) {
      const detail = (body && (body.detail ?? body.message)) ?? `HTTP ${res.status}`;
      throw new ApiError(res.status, String(detail));
    }
    return body as T;
  } catch (err: any) {
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    if (err.name === "AbortError") {
      throw new ApiError(408, "서버 응답 시간이 초과되었습니다. 네트워크 상태를 확인해주세요.");
    }
    throw err;
  }
}

export const api = {
  anonymous: () => request<AuthResponse>("/auth/anonymous", { method: "POST" }),
  me: () => request<{ user: AuthResponse["user"] }>("/auth/me"),
  updateProfile: (payload: any) => request<any>("/auth/me/profile", { method: "PUT", body: JSON.stringify(payload) }),
  linkProvider: (provider: string, token: string) => request<AuthResponse>(`/auth/link/${provider}`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ provider_token: token }) }),
  purchase: (product_id: string) => request<any>("/auth/me/purchase", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ product_id, receipt: "mock_valid_receipt" }) }),
  deleteAccount: () => request<void>("/auth/me", { method: "DELETE" }),
  calculate: (payload: SajuRequest) =>
    request<SajuResponse>("/saju/calculate", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(payload) }),
  report: (payload: ReportRequest) =>
    request<ReportResponse>("/saju/report", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(payload) }),
  daily: (payload: SajuRequest & { days?: number; target_date?: string; lang?: string }) =>
    request<DailyResponse>("/saju/daily", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(payload) }),
  compatibility: (payload: CompatibilityRequest) =>
    request<CompatibilityResponse>("/saju/compatibility", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(payload) }),
  registerPushToken: (payload: PushTokenRequest) =>
    request<{ registered: boolean; tokens: number }>("/auth/me/push-token", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(payload) }),
};

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Modal, View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ActivityIndicator } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { colors, radius, spacing } from "@/theme";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/store/authStore";

interface Props {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: () => void;
}

export function SocialLoginModal({ visible, onClose, onSuccess }: Props) {
  const linkAccount = useAuthStore((s) => s.linkAccount);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleLogin = async (provider: "apple" | "google" | "kakao") => {
    setLoading(provider);
    try {
      await linkAccount(provider);
      onSuccess();
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert(e.message || "로그인에 실패했습니다.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <View style={styles.overlay}>
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.title}>계정 연결</Text>
          <Text style={styles.desc}>
            기기를 변경하거나 앱을 삭제해도{"\n"}내 사주 데이터와 결제 정보를 안전하게 보관합니다.
          </Text>

          <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.btn, styles.appleBtn]} onPress={() => handleLogin("apple")} disabled={!!loading}>
            {loading === "apple" ? <ActivityIndicator color="#FFF" /> : (
              <>
                <Ionicons name="logo-apple" size={20} color="#FFF" />
                <Text style={styles.btnTextWhite}>Apple로 계속하기</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.btn, styles.googleBtn]} onPress={() => handleLogin("google")} disabled={!!loading}>
            {loading === "google" ? <ActivityIndicator color="#000" /> : (
              <>
                <Ionicons name="logo-google" size={20} color="#000" />
                <Text style={styles.btnTextBlack}>Google로 계속하기</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.btn, styles.kakaoBtn]} onPress={() => handleLogin("kakao")} disabled={!!loading}>
            {loading === "kakao" ? <ActivityIndicator color="#000" /> : (
              <>
                <Ionicons name="chatbubble" size={20} color="#000" />
                <Text style={styles.btnTextBlack}>카카오로 계속하기</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.closeBtn} onPress={onClose} disabled={!!loading}>
            <Text style={styles.closeText}>나중에 하기</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({

=== FILE: frontend/src/store/authStore.ts ===
﻿import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { AuthResponse } from '../../types';
import { api, setAuthToken } from '../api/client';
import { storage } from './secureStore'; // 👈 새로 만든 래퍼 사용

const TOKEN_KEY = 'saju.access_token';
type User = AuthResponse['user'];

interface AuthState {
  user: User | null;
  ready: boolean;
  bootstrap: () => Promise<void>;
  linkAccount: (provider: "apple" | "google" | "kakao") => Promise<void>;
  signInAnonymous: () => Promise<void>;
  signOut: () => Promise<void>;
}

export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>((set) => ({
  user: null,
  ready: false,
  bootstrap: async () => {
    let t = await storage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);

    // 1. 토큰이 없는 경우 -> 새 계정 생성
    if (!t) {
      try {
        const res = await api.anonymous();
        await storage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, res.access_token);
        setAuthToken(res.access_token);
        set({ user: res.user, ready: true });
      } catch (e) {
        set({ ready: true });
      }
      return;
    }

    // 2. 토큰이 있는 경우 -> 유효성 검사
    setAuthToken(t);
    try {
      const me = await api.me();
      set({ user: me.user, ready: true });
    } catch {
      // 토큰이 만료되었으면 새로 생성
      try {
        const res = await api.anonymous();
        await storage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, res.access_token);
        setAuthToken(res.access_token);
        set({ user: res.user, ready: true });
      } catch (e) {
        set({ ready: true });
      }
    }
  },
  linkAccount: async (provider: "apple" | "google" | "kakao") => {
    // [시뮬레이션] 실제 앱에서는 Apple/Google SDK에서 받은 진짜 토큰을 넣습니다.
    const mockToken = `mock:${provider}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10)}`;
    const res = await api.linkProvider(provider, mockToken);
    await storage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, res.access_token);
    setAuthToken(res.access_token);
    set({ user: res.user });
  },
  signInAnonymous: async () => {
    const res = await api.anonymous();
    await storage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, res.access_token);
    setAuthToken(res.access_token);
    set({ user: res.user });
  },
  signOut: async () => {
    await storage.deleteItem(TOKEN_KEY);
    setAuthToken(null);
    set({ user: null });
  },
}));

=== FILE: frontend/src/store/profileStore.ts ===
﻿import { create } from "zustand";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";
import { api } from "../api/client";

const PROFILE_KEY = "saju_profile";

interface ProfileState {
  profile: any | null;
  ready: boolean;
  loadProfile: () => Promise<void>;
  saveProfile: (profile: any) => Promise<void>;
  clearProfile: () => Promise<void>;
}

export const useProfileStore = create<ProfileState>((set) => ({
  profile: null,
  ready: false,
  loadProfile: async () => {
    try {
      const data = await AsyncStorage.getItem(PROFILE_KEY);
      if (data) {
        set({ profile: JSON.parse(data), ready: true });
      } else {
        set({ ready: true });
      }
    } catch {
      set({ ready: true });
    }
  },
  saveProfile: async (profile: any) => {
    // 1. 로컬 저장 (오프라인/새로고침 대비)
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(PROFILE_KEY, JSON.stringify(profile));
    set({ profile });

    // 2. 서버 동기화 (에러가 나도 로컬은 유지)
    try {
      await api.updateProfile(profile);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Server profile sync failed (using local cache):", e);
    }
  },
  clearProfile: async () => {
    await AsyncStorage.removeItem(PROFILE_KEY);
    set({ profile: null });
  },
}));


=== FILE: frontend/src/store/secureStore.ts ===
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import * as SecureStore from 'expo-secure-store';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

// 웹에서는 AsyncStorage, 네이티브에서는 SecureStore 사용
export const storage = {
  async getItem(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      return AsyncStorage.getItem(key);
    }
    return SecureStore.getItemAsync(key);
  },

  async setItem(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      return AsyncStorage.setItem(key, value);
    }
    return SecureStore.setItemAsync(key, value);
  },

  async deleteItem(key: string): Promise<void> {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      return AsyncStorage.removeItem(key);
    }
    return SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(key);
  },
};

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
scripts/deepen_personalization.py

프리미엄 콘텐츠(love, career, wealth)에 다차원 개인화 엔진 적용.
사주의 아키타입 + 에너지 강도 + 주 오행 + 십성 모드를 조합하여
유저마다 완전히 다른 맞춤형 문단(personalized_insight)을 동적 생성합니다.
"""
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend"

def patch_file(rel_path, old, new, label, is_frontend=True):
    base = FRONTEND if is_frontend else ROOT
    p = base / rel_path
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"  [!!] {p} 없음")
        return
    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if new in text:
        print(f"  [--] {label}: 이미 적용됨")
        return
    if old not in text:
        print(f"  [!!] {label}: 대상 문자열 불일치")
        return
    p.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"  [OK] {label}")

def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("  다차원 개인화 엔진(Dynamic Personalization) 적용")
    print("=" * 60)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. content_writer.py 에 동적 개인화 텍스트 생성 로직 추가
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    old_premium_func = '''def write_premium_section(profile: dict, lang: str, section_name: str) -> dict | None:
    try:
        pack = load_pack(lang, section_name)
    except KeyError:
        return None
        
    arch = profile["archetype"]["key"]
    content_map = pack.get("CONTENT", {})
    content = content_map.get(arch, {"headline": "Premium feature", "body": "Analyze your chart deeply."})
    
    return {
        "id": section_name,
        "title": pack.get("SECTION_TITLE", section_name.title()),
        "mode": arch,
        "headline": content.get("headline", ""),
        "body": content.get("body", ""),
        "patterns": content.get("patterns", []),
        "compatibility": {
            "best_match": content.get("best_match", []),
            "best_reason": content.get("best_reason", ""),
            "challenging_match": content.get("challenging_match", []),
            "challenging_reason": content.get("challenging_reason", ""),
        },
        "actions": content.get("actions", []),
        "red_flags": content.get("red_flags", []),
    }'''

    new_premium_func = '''def write_premium_section(profile: dict, lang: str, section_name: str) -> dict | None:
    try:

    # ----------------------------------------------------

    intensity = profile["archetype"].get("intensity", "BALANCED_CORE")

    dom_elem = dom_elems[0] if dom_elems else "BALANCED"

    return {

        "mode": arch,
        "headline": content.get("headline", ""),
        "body": final_body,
        "patterns": content.get("patterns", []),
        "compatibility": {
            "best_match": content.get("best_match", []),
            "best_reason": content.get("best_reason", ""),
            "challenging_match": content.get("challenging_match", []),
            "challenging_reason": content.get("challenging_reason", ""),
        },
        "actions": content.get("actions", []),
        "red_flags": content.get("red_flags", []),
    }'''

    patch_file(
        "app/services/content_writer.py",
        old_premium_func,
        new_premium_func,
        "content_writer.py 다차원 개인화 엔진 적용",
        is_frontend=False
    )

    print("\n[git] add → commit → push")
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "feat(personalization): dynamic content generation based on multi-dimensional saju data (intensity + element + ten gods)"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        print("\n[done] 커밋 + 푸시 완료")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        print("\n[!!] git 커밋 실패")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# 2. 영문 번역 (요약본 자동 생성)

def to_en(kr_data, mode_name):
    """한국어 데이터를 영어 구조로 변환 (간략화)"""
    return {
        "headline": f"Your {mode_name} mode shines in your unique way.",
        "body": "This section provides deep insight into your chart. Unlock the full report for personalized guidance.",
        "patterns": ["Pattern 1", "Pattern 2", "Pattern 3"],
        "best_match": ["THE_ANCHOR", "THE_MENTOR"],
        "best_reason": "A balanced partner who supports your unique traits.",
        "challenging_match": ["THE_CHALLENGER"],
        "challenging_reason": "Conflicting styles may require conscious effort.",
        "actions": ["Action 1", "Action 2", "Action 3"],
        "red_flags": ["Watch for overextension.", "Avoid neglecting self-care."]
    }

def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("  기존 아코디언(재물/일/인연) 콘텐츠 확장")
    print("=" * 60)

    # 1. JSON 데이터 업데이트
    for lang in ["ko", "en"]:
        data_path = DATA_DIR / lang / "sections.json"
        if not data_path.exists():
            print(f"  [!!] {data_path} 없음")
            continue

        sections = json.loads(data_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        
        if lang == "ko":
            sections["MONEY_CONTENT"] = MONEY_CONTENT
            sections["WORK_CONTENT"] = WORK_CONTENT
            sections["BONDS_CONTENT"] = BONDS_CONTENT
        else:
            sections["MONEY_CONTENT"] = {k: to_en(v, k) for k, v in MONEY_CONTENT.items()}
            sections["WORK_CONTENT"] = {k: to_en(v, k) for k, v in WORK_CONTENT.items()}
            sections["BONDS_CONTENT"] = {k: to_en(v, k) for k, v in BONDS_CONTENT.items()}

        data_path.write_text(json.dumps(sections, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"  [OK] {data_path.relative_to(ROOT)} 업데이트")

    # 2. content_writer.py 수정 (확장 필드 반환)
    p_writer = ROOT / "app" / "services" / "content_writer.py"
    text = p_writer.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    
    old_func = '''def _write_mode_section(profile: dict, lang: str, section_id: str,
                        mode_key: str) -> dict:
    pack = load_pack(lang, "sections")
    key_map = {
        "money": "MONEY_CONTENT",
        "work": "WORK_CONTENT",
        "bonds": "BONDS_CONTENT",
    }
    content_map = pack.get(key_map[section_id], {})
    content = content_map.get(mode_key, {})

    return {
        "id": section_id,
        "title": _title(lang, section_id),
        "mode": mode_key,
        "headline": content.get("headline", ""),
        "body": content.get("body", ""),
        "action": content.get("action", ""),
    }'''
    
    new_func = '''def _write_mode_section(profile: dict, lang: str, section_id: str,
                        mode_key: str) -> dict:
    pack = load_pack(lang, "sections")
    key_map = {
        "money": "MONEY_CONTENT",
        "work": "WORK_CONTENT",
        "bonds": "BONDS_CONTENT",
    }
    content_map = pack.get(key_map[section_id], {})
    content = content_map.get(mode_key, {})

    return {
        "id": section_id,
        "title": _title(lang, section_id),
        "mode": mode_key,
        "headline": content.get("headline", ""),
        "body": content.get("body", ""),
        "patterns": content.get("patterns", []),
        "compatibility": {
            "best_match": content.get("best_match", []),
            "best_reason": content.get("best_reason", ""),
            "challenging_match": content.get("challenging_match", []),
            "challenging_reason": content.get("challenging_reason", ""),
        },
        "actions": content.get("actions", []),
        "red_flags": content.get("red_flags", []),
    }'''
    
    if old_func in text:
        text = text.replace(old_func, new_func)
        p_writer.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        print("  [OK] content_writer.py: _write_mode_section 확장 필드 반환")
    else:
        print("  [--] content_writer.py: 이미 적용됨 or 패턴 불일치")

    # 3. home.tsx 렌더링 일반화 (love/career/wealth 하드코딩 제거)
    p_home = FRONTEND / "app" / "(tabs)" / "home.tsx"
    text = p_home.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    
    old_render = '''                  {/* Premium Sections (Love, Career, Wealth) */}
                  {["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key) && sec.patterns && sec.patterns.length > 0 && ('''
                  
    new_render = '''                  {/* Dynamic Sections (Love, Career, Wealth, Money, Work, Bonds) */}
                  {sec.patterns && sec.patterns.length > 0 && ('''
                  
    text = text.replace(old_render, new_render)
    
    # 나머지 `["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key)` 조건들도 모두 일반화
    text = text.replace('{["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key) && sec.compatibility && (', '{sec.compatibility && (')
    text = text.replace('{["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key) && sec.actions && sec.actions.length > 0 && (', '{sec.actions && sec.actions.length > 0 && (')
    text = text.replace('{["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key) && sec.red_flags && sec.red_flags.length > 0 && (', '{sec.red_flags && sec.red_flags.length > 0 && (')
    text = text.replace('{["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key) && !sec.patterns && (', '{!sec.patterns && isLocked && (')
    
    p_home.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    print("  [OK] home.tsx: 렌더링 로직 일반화 (모든 섹션 확장 필드 대응)")

    print("\n[git] add → commit → push")
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "content: expand standard sections (money, work, bonds) to match deep report depth"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        print("\n[done] 커밋 + 푸시 완료")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        print("\n[!!] git 커밋 실패")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
scripts/expand_standard_content_fixed.py

이전 expand_standard_content.py의 pre-flight 이슈 4종을 모두 반영한 수정판.

변경점:
  1) content_writer.py — 'action'(단수) 하위 호환 필드 유지 (기존 테스트/프론트 보호)
  2) 미정의 모드 참조(THE_ANCHOR, THE_PIONEER, THE_BLADE)를 정의된 모드로 별칭 치환
  3) home.tsx — isLocked 스코프, sec.body 렌더, sec.advice 잔재 사전 검증 후 경고
  4) 실행 후 JSON 유효성 + 모드 참조 유효성 자체 검증
  5) 재실행 안전 (idempotent) — 이미 적용된 경우 skip

사용법:
  python scripts/expand_standard_content_fixed.py --dry-run   # 미리보기
  python scripts/expand_standard_content_fixed.py             # 파일만 수정
  python scripts/expand_standard_content_fixed.py --commit    # 수정 + git commit/push
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT      = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DATA_DIR  = ROOT / "app" / "services" / "content" / "data"
FRONTEND  = ROOT / "frontend"
WRITER    = ROOT / "app" / "services" / "content_writer.py"
HOME      = FRONTEND / "app" / "(tabs)" / "home.tsx"

}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 헬퍼
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def normalize_content(data: dict) -> dict:
    """별칭 치환 + 중복 제거(자기 참조 방지)."""
    for mode, entry in data.items():
        for field in ("best_match", "challenging_match"):
            if field in entry:
                seen, out = set(), []
                for m in entry[field]:
                    m2 = MODE_ALIASES.get(m, m)
                    if m2 == mode:      # 자기 자신은 궁합에서 제외
                        continue
                    if m2 in seen:
                        continue
                    seen.add(m2); out.append(m2)
                entry[field] = out
    return data


def to_en(kr_data: dict) -> dict:
    """영문 최소 placeholder. 필요 시 실제 번역으로 대체."""
    return {
        "headline": kr_data["headline"][:60] + "...",
        "body": kr_data["body"],
        "patterns": kr_data["patterns"],
        "best_match": kr_data["best_match"],
        "best_reason": kr_data["best_reason"],
        "challenging_match": kr_data["challenging_match"],
        "challenging_reason": kr_data["challenging_reason"],
        "actions": kr_data["actions"],
        "red_flags": kr_data["red_flags"],
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 1: sections.json 갱신
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def patch_sections(dry_run: bool) -> None:
    money = normalize_content(MONEY_CONTENT)
    work  = normalize_content(WORK_CONTENT)
    bonds = normalize_content(BONDS_CONTENT)

    for lang in ("ko", "en"):
        path = DATA_DIR / lang / "sections.json"
        if not path.exists():
            print(f"  [!!] 없음: {path}")
            continue

        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if lang == "ko":
            data["MONEY_CONTENT"] = money
            data["WORK_CONTENT"]  = work
            data["BONDS_CONTENT"] = bonds
        else:
            data["MONEY_CONTENT"] = {k: to_en(v) for k, v in money.items()}
            data["WORK_CONTENT"]  = {k: to_en(v) for k, v in work.items()}
            data["BONDS_CONTENT"] = {k: to_en(v) for k, v in bonds.items()}

        payload = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        if dry_run:
            print(f"  [dry] {path.relative_to(ROOT)} (bytes={len(payload)})")
        else:
            path.write_text(payload, encoding="utf-8")
            print(f"  [OK ] {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")

    # 자체 검증: 모드 참조 유효성
    defined = set(money) | set(work) | set(bonds)
    problems = []
    for name, data in (("MONEY", money), ("WORK", work), ("BONDS", bonds)):
        for mode, entry in data.items():
            for field in ("best_match", "challenging_match"):
                for m in entry[field]:
                    if m not in defined:
                        problems.append(f"{name}.{mode}.{field} → {m} (미정의)")
    if problems:
        print("  [WARN] 미정의 모드 참조:")
        for p in problems:
            print(f"        - {p}")
    else:
        print("  [OK ] 모드 참조 유효성 검증 통과")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 2: content_writer.py — 하위 호환 action 필드 유지하며 return 블록 교체
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def patch_writer(dry_run: bool) -> None:
    text = WRITER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    if '"action": (content.get("actions") or [""])[0]' in text:
        print("  [-- ] content_writer.py: 이미 backward-compat 적용됨")
        return

    marker = "def _write_mode_section("
    if marker not in text:
        print("  [!! ] content_writer.py: _write_mode_section 함수 없음")
        return

    start = text.index(marker)
    ret_idx = text.find("return {", start)
    if ret_idx == -1:
        print("  [!! ] content_writer.py: return 블록 없음")
        return

    # 중괄호 매칭으로 return {...} 블록 끝 찾기
    brace_start = text.index("{", ret_idx)
    depth, i = 0, brace_start
    while i < len(text):
        if text[i] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif text[i] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                brace_end = i
                break
        i += 1
    else:
        print("  [!! ] content_writer.py: return 블록 매칭 실패")
        return

    new_return = '''return {
        "id": section_id,
        "title": _title(lang, section_id),
        "mode": mode_key,
        "headline": content.get("headline", ""),
        "body": content.get("body", ""),
        # backward compat (기존 단수 'action' 필드 유지)
        "action": (content.get("actions") or [""])[0],
        # rich fields (프리미엄 렌더)
        "patterns": content.get("patterns", []),
        "compatibility": {
            "best_match": content.get("best_match", []),
            "best_reason": content.get("best_reason", ""),
            "challenging_match": content.get("challenging_match", []),
            "challenging_reason": content.get("challenging_reason", ""),
        },
        "actions": content.get("actions", []),
        "red_flags": content.get("red_flags", []),
    }'''

    new_text = text[:ret_idx] + new_return + text[brace_end + 1:]

    # 컴파일 검증
    try:
        compile(new_text, str(WRITER), "exec")
    except SyntaxError as e:
        print(f"  [!! ] content_writer.py 컴파일 실패: {e}")
        return

    if dry_run:
        print("  [dry] content_writer.py return 블록 교체 예정")
    else:
        WRITER.write_text(new_text, encoding="utf-8")
        print("  [OK ] content_writer.py: backward-compat + rich fields 반영")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 3: home.tsx — 사전 검증 + 안전 치환
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def patch_home(dry_run: bool) -> None:
    if not HOME.exists():
        print(f"  [!! ] 없음: {HOME}")
        return

    text = HOME.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    warnings: list[str] = []

    # 사전 검증
    if "isLocked" not in text:
        warnings.append("isLocked 변수 없음 → 잠금 처리 블록 수동 확인 필요")
    if "sec.body" not in text:
        warnings.append("sec.body 렌더 코드 없음 → 프리미엄 블록 안에서 body 문단이 사라질 위험. 해당 블록에 {sec.body && <Text style={styles.paragraph}>{sec.body}</Text>} 삽입 필요")
    if "sec.advice" in text:
        warnings.append("sec.advice 참조 남음 → sec.actions 또는 sec.action으로 교체 권장")

    # 하드코딩 조건 일반화 (이미 반영된 경우 no-op)
    replacements = [
        ('{["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key) && sec.patterns && sec.patterns.length > 0 && (',
         '{sec.patterns && sec.patterns.length > 0 && ('),
        ('{["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key) && sec.compatibility && (',
         '{sec.compatibility && ('),
        ('{["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key) && sec.actions && sec.actions.length > 0 && (',
         '{sec.actions && sec.actions.length > 0 && ('),
        ('{["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key) && sec.red_flags && sec.red_flags.length > 0 && (',
         '{sec.red_flags && sec.red_flags.length > 0 && ('),
        # 마지막 조건은 isLocked 스코프가 보장될 때만
        ('{["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key) && !sec.patterns && (',
         '{!sec.patterns && isLocked && ('),
    ]

    changed = 0
    for old, new in replacements:
        if old in text:
            text = text.replace(old, new)
            changed += 1

    if dry_run:
        print(f"  [dry] home.tsx 치환 {changed}건 예정")
    elif changed:
        HOME.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"  [OK ] home.tsx: 조건 일반화 {changed}건 반영")
    else:
        print("  [-- ] home.tsx: 하드코딩 조건 없음 (이미 적용됨)")

    if warnings:
        print("  [WARN] home.tsx 수동 확인 권장:")
        for w in warnings:
            print(f"        - {w}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 4: 테스트 및 (옵션) git commit/push
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def run_tests() -> bool:
    import subprocess
    print("\n[pytest] 백엔드 테스트")
    r = subprocess.run(["python", "-m", "pytest", "-q"], cwd=ROOT)
    return r.returncode == 0


def git_commit_push() -> None:
    import subprocess
    print("\n[git] add → commit → push")
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        subprocess.run(
            ["git", "commit", "-m",
             "content: expand standard sections (money, work, bonds) with rich fields + backward-compat action"],
            cwd=ROOT, check=True,
        )
        subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        print("[done] 커밋 + 푸시 완료")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"[!!] git 실패: {e}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="파일 미수정, 미리보기만")
    ap.add_argument("--commit",  action="store_true", help="적용 후 git commit/push")
    ap.add_argument("--skip-tests", action="store_true", help="pytest 생략")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    print("=" * 62)
    print("  expand_standard_content_fixed.py")
    print("=" * 62)

    print("\n[1] sections.json 갱신")
    patch_sections(args.dry_run)

    print("\n[2] content_writer.py 패치")
    patch_writer(args.dry_run)

    print("\n[3] home.tsx 패치")
    patch_home(args.dry_run)

    if args.dry_run:
        print("\n[dry-run 종료] 실제 파일은 변경되지 않았습니다.")
        return 0

    if not args.skip_tests:
        ok = run_tests()
        if not ok:
            print("\n[!!] pytest 실패 → 커밋 중단. 위 에러를 확인하세요.")
            return 1

    if args.commit:
        git_commit_push()

    print("\n[안내] 프론트엔드는 별도 재빌드, 백엔드는 Cloud Run 재배포가 필요합니다.")
    print("       배포 후 무료/유료 계정으로 재물/일/인연 아코디언 6종을 모두 확인하세요.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
scripts/fix_iap_test.py

iap.py의 상품 ID 변경(sub_monthly_299)에 맞춰 테스트 코드(test_security_hardening.py)를 업데이트합니다.
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
TARGET = ROOT / "tests" / "test_security_hardening.py"

def main():
    if not TARGET.exists():
        print(f"[-] {TARGET} 파일이 없습니다.")
        sys.exit(1)

    text = TARGET.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    
    # 옛날 상품 ID를 새로운 상품 ID로 변경
    text = text.replace('"premium_monthly"', '"sub_monthly_299"')
    
    TARGET.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    print("[OK] tests/test_security_hardening.py의 상품 ID가 업데이트되었습니다.")
    print("다음 명령으로 전체 테스트를 다시 실행해 보세요:")

RESET = "\033[0m"
BOLD = "\033[1m"
DIM = "\033[2m"
CYAN = "\033[36m"
YELLOW = "\033[33m"
GREEN = "\033[32m"
MAGENTA = "\033[35m"
RED = "\033[31m"
BG_GREEN = "\033[42m"

WIDTH = 78


def hr(char="─"):
    print(char * WIDTH)


def header(text):
    print()
    hr("═")
    print(f"{BOLD}{text}{RESET}")
    hr("═")


def section(title):
    print()
    hr("─")
    print(f"{BOLD}{CYAN}{title}{RESET}")
    hr("─")


def para(text):
    print(f"  {text}")


def bullet(text, sym="•"):
    print(f"  {sym} {text}")


def render_chart(report):
    if "chart" not in report["sections"]:
        return
    chart = report["sections"]["chart"]
    section(chart["title"])
    print(f"  {DIM}{chart['hero']}{RESET}")
    print()
    for layer in chart["layers"]:
        marker = "← YOU" if layer["is_self"] else ""
        print(
            f"  {BOLD}{layer['label']}{RESET}  ·  "
            f"{layer['archetype']}  ·  {DIM}{layer['element']}{RESET}  "
            f"{GREEN}{marker}{RESET}"
        )
        print(f"    {DIM}{layer['role']}{RESET}")
        print(f"    {layer.get('narrative', '')}")
        print()
    for note in chart.get("notes", []):
        print(f"  {MAGENTA}※ {note}{RESET}")
    print()

        avoid = p_domains.get("avoid") or []
        if avoid:
            label = domain_ko.get("avoid", "avoid") if lang == "ko" else "avoid"
            print(f"    {RED}{label}:{RESET} {', '.join(avoid)}")

    if lc.get("watch_out"):
        names = [w["name"] for w in lc["watch_out"]]
        print(f"\n  {RED}{watch_label}:{RESET} {', '.join(names)}")
