def render_daily(profile, lang, target_date=None):
    """일운(Daily) 7일치 출력"""
    if target_date is None:
        target_date = date.today()

    day_stem = profile["archetype"]["stem"]

    # yongsin_info 는 dict 이어야 함 (daewoon_score._element_score 계약)
    lc = profile["lucky_code"]
    yongsin_info = {
        "yongsin": lc.get("power_element", ""),
        "huisin":  lc.get("support_element", ""),
        "gisin":   lc.get("watch_out_elements", []),
    }

    try:
        items = calculate_daily_range(target_date, 7, day_stem, yongsin_info)
        sec = write_daily_section(items, lang=lang)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ❌ 일운 생성 실패: {e}")
        return

    section(sec.get("title") or ("Daily" if lang == "en" else "일운"))
    print(f"  {DIM}{sec.get('hero', '')}{RESET}")
    print()

    grade_color = {
        "PEAK": GREEN + BOLD,
        "FAVORABLE": GREEN,
        "NEUTRAL": "",
        "CAUTION": YELLOW,
        "CHALLENGING": RED,
    }
    watch_label = "Watch" if lang == "en" else "주의"
    lean_label  = "Lean"  if lang == "en" else "집중"

    for item in sec["items"]:
        color = grade_color.get(item.get("grade", ""), "")
        is_today = (item.get("date") == target_date.isoformat())
        today_marker = f"{BG_GREEN}{BOLD} TODAY {RESET}" if is_today else "       "

        print(
            f" {today_marker} {BOLD}{item.get('date', '')}{RESET}  "
            f"{item.get('day_pillar', '')}  "
            f"{color}{item.get('grade_label', '')}{RESET}"
        )
        print(f"    {item.get('name', '')} — {item.get('headline', '')}")
        body_text = item.get('body', '')
        for para in body_text.split("\n\n"):
            if para.strip():
                print(f"    {DIM}{para.strip()}{RESET}")
        print(f"    {MAGENTA}{watch_label}:{RESET} {item.get('watch_for', '')}")
        print(f"    {GREEN}{lean_label}:{RESET} {item.get('lean_into', '')}")
        print()


def render_timeline(report, lang="en"):
    import unicodedata

    def pad(s, width):
        # 한글은 2칸, 영문은 1칸으로 계산해서 정렬
        w = sum(2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(c) in "WF" else 1 for c in s)
        return s + " " * max(0, width - w)

    tl = report["sections"]["timeline"]
    section(tl["title"])
    print(f"  {DIM}{tl['hero']}{RESET}")
    print()

    grade_labels = {
        "en": {
            "PEAK": "Peak", "FAVORABLE": "Favorable", "NEUTRAL": "Neutral",
            "CAUTION": "Caution", "CHALLENGING": "Challenging",
        },
        "ko": {
            "PEAK": "대길", "FAVORABLE": "순풍", "NEUTRAL": "중립",
            "CAUTION": "주의", "CHALLENGING": "무거움",
        },
    }.get(lang, {})

    for item in tl["items"]:
        grade = item["grade"]
        label = grade_labels.get(grade, grade)
        color = {
            "PEAK": GREEN + BOLD,
            "FAVORABLE": GREEN,
            "NEUTRAL": "",
            "CAUTION": YELLOW,
            "CHALLENGING": RED,
        }.get(grade, "")
        ages = f"{item['ages'][0]:>2}–{item['ages'][1]:<3}"
        score = f"{item['score']:+.1f}"
        now_marker = f"{BG_GREEN}{BOLD} NOW {RESET}" if item.get("is_current") else "     "
        print(
            f" {now_marker} {ages}  {item['pillar']}  "
            f"{color}{pad(label, 12)}{RESET} {DIM}{score}{RESET}  {item['blurb']}"
        )

def render_disclaimer(report):
    print()
    hr("─")
    print(f"  {DIM}{report['disclaimer']}{RESET}")
    hr("─")


def build_report(birth_date, birth_time, birth_time_mode, gender, target_year, lang, city, longitude, timezone_str):
    kwargs = dict(
        birth_date=birth_date,
        birth_time=birth_time,
        birth_time_mode=birth_time_mode,
        correction_mode="lmt",
        jasi_boundary=23,
        gender=gender,
    )
    if city:
        kwargs["birth_location"] = city
    else:
        kwargs["longitude"] = longitude
        kwargs["timezone_str"] = timezone_str
    if target_year:
        kwargs["target_year"] = target_year

    result = calculate_saju(**kwargs)
    profile = build_semantic_profile(result)
    return result, profile, generate_full_report(profile, lang=lang)


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("birth_date")
    p.add_argument("birth_time", nargs="?", default=None)
    p.add_argument(
        "--birth-time-mode",
        default="exact",
        choices=["exact", "noon", "day_only"],
    )
    p.add_argument("--gender", default="M", choices=["M", "F"])
    p.add_argument("--target-year", type=int, default=None)
    p.add_argument("--daily-date", default=None, help="일운 기준일 (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    p.add_argument("--lang", default="ko", choices=["en", "ko", "ja", "zh_cn", "zh_tw", "both", "all"])
    p.add_argument("--city", default=None)
    p.add_argument("--longitude", type=float, default=126.9780)
    p.add_argument("--timezone", default="Asia/Seoul")
    args = p.parse_args()

    if args.lang == "both":
        langs = ["en", "ko"]
    elif args.lang == "all":
        langs = ["en", "ko", "ja", "zh_cn"]
    else:
        langs = [args.lang]
    result, _, _ = build_report(
        args.birth_date, args.birth_time, args.birth_time_mode, args.gender,
        args.target_year, "en", args.city, args.longitude, args.timezone,
    )

    print()
    hr("═")
    print(f"{BOLD}{args.birth_date}  {args.birth_time}  ({args.gender}){RESET}")
    if args.city:
        print(f"  city: {args.city}  |  region: {result.get('region')}")
    hr("═")

    pillars_label = "Four Pillars" if args.lang == "en" else "四柱"
    hp = result.get('hour_pillar') or "—"
    print(
        f"  {pillars_label}   "
        f"{result['year_pillar']}  {result['month_pillar']}  "
        f"{result['day_pillar']}  {hp}"
    )
    if args.lang in ("ko", "both"):
        from app.services.template_interpreter import HANJA_TO_HANGUL
        readings = "  ".join(
            "".join(HANJA_TO_HANGUL.get(c, c) for c in p)
            for p in (
                result["year_pillar"], result["month_pillar"],
                result["day_pillar"], result.get("hour_pillar") or "",
            )
        )
        print(f"  읽기          {readings}")
    print(f"  LMT    {result['solar_adjusted_time']}")
    print(f"  UTC    {result['birth_instant_utc']}")

    for lang in langs:
        _, profile, report = build_report(
            args.birth_date, args.birth_time, args.birth_time_mode, args.gender,
            args.target_year, lang, args.city, args.longitude, args.timezone,
        )
        header(f"[{lang.upper()}]")
        render_chart(report)
        render_cover(report, lang)
        render_summary_cards(report, lang)
        render_core(report, lang)
        render_energy(report, lang)
        render_lucky_code(report, lang)
        render_health(report, lang)
        render_age_band(report, lang)
        render_sinsal(report, lang)
        render_mode_section(report, "money", lang)
        render_mode_section(report, "work", lang)
        render_mode_section(report, "bonds", lang)
        render_year(report, lang)
        render_monthly(report, lang)

        # ===== 일운 출력 (7일) =====
        try:
            from datetime import datetime as _dt
            _target_date = None
            if getattr(args, "daily_date", None):
                _target_date = _dt.strptime(args.daily_date, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
            render_daily(profile, lang, _target_date)
        except Exception as _e:
            print(f"  ⚠️ 일운 출력 실패: {_e}")

        render_timeline(report, lang)
        render_disclaimer(report)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
scripts/update_payment_usd.py

수익화 모델 달러($)화 적용
  1. iap.py: 상품 ID 변경 (sub_monthly_299, addon_deep_099, addon_compat_199)
  2. PaymentModal.tsx: 글로벌 달러 가격 표기 및 영문/국문 병기 UI
"""
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend"

def patch_iap():
    p = ROOT / "app" / "services" / "iap.py"
    if not p.exists(): return
    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    
    text = text.replace('"premium_monthly"', '"sub_monthly_299"')
    text = text.replace('"addon_compatibility"', '"addon_compat_199"')
    text = text.replace('"addon_deep_990"', '"addon_deep_099"')
    
    # 기존 로직이 남아있을 경우를 대비해 확실하게 교체
    if '"sub_monthly_299"' not in text:
        text = text.replace(
            'if product_id == "sub_monthly_3900":',
            'if product_id == "sub_monthly_299":'
        ).replace(
            'if product_id == "addon_compat_1900":',
            'if product_id == "addon_compat_199":'
        )
        
    p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    print("  [OK] iap.py: 상품 ID 달러 기준으로 업데이트")

NEW_PAYMENT_MODAL = '''import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Modal, View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ActivityIndicator, Alert } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { colors, radius, spacing } from "@/theme";
import { api } from "@/api/client";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/store/authStore";

interface Props {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function PaymentModal({ visible, onClose }: Props) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const bootstrap = useAuthStore((s) => s.bootstrap);

  const handlePay = async (productId: string) => {
    setLoading(productId);
    try {
      await api.purchase(productId);
      await bootstrap(); // 유저 정보(티어/애드온) 갱신
      Alert.alert("Payment Successful", "The locked content has been unlocked.");
      onClose();
      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
        window.location.reload();
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      Alert.alert("Payment Failed", e.message || "Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="slide" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <View style={styles.overlay}>
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.header}>
            <Text style={styles.title}>Gyeol Premium</Text>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={onClose} style={styles.closeIcon}>
              <Ionicons name="close" size={24} color={colors.textMuted} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.desc}>Choose the plan that fits your journey.</Text>

          {/* 1. 구독 */}
          <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.planBox, { borderColor: colors.primary, backgroundColor: colors.primary + "05" }]} onPress={() => handlePay("sub_monthly_299")} disabled={!!loading}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>

              </View>
              <Text style={styles.planDetail}>Daily, Monthly & All Deep Reports</Text>
              <Text style={styles.planPrice}>$2.99 / month</Text>
            </View>
            {loading === "sub_monthly_299" ? <ActivityIndicator color={colors.primary} /> : <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={24} color={colors.primary} />}
          </TouchableOpacity>

          {/* 2. 심화 리포트 단건 */}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
scripts/update_premium_renderer.py

확장된 프리미엄 콘텐츠 필드(patterns/compatibility/actions/red_flags)를
백엔드에서 반환하고, 프론트엔드에서 렌더링하도록 수정.
"""
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend"

def patch(rel_path, old, new, label, is_frontend=True):
    base = FRONTEND if is_frontend else ROOT
    p = base / rel_path
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"  [!!] {rel_path} 없음")
        return
    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if new in text:
        print(f"  [--] {label}: 이미 적용됨")
        return
    if old not in text:
        print(f"  [!!] {label}: 대상 문자열 불일치")
        return
    p.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"  [OK] {label}")

def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("  프리미엄 렌더러 업데이트")
    print("=" * 60)
    print()

    # 1. content_writer.py: write_premium_section 확장
    patch(
        "app/services/content_writer.py",
        '''    return {
        "id": section_name,
        "title": pack.get("SECTION_TITLE", section_name.title()),
        "mode": arch,
        "headline": content.get("headline", ""),
        "body": content.get("body", ""),
        "action": "꾸준한 기록과 실행이 필요합니다." if lang == "ko" else "Consistent action is required.",
    }''',
        '''    return {
        "id": section_name,
        "title": pack.get("SECTION_TITLE", section_name.title()),
        "mode": arch,

        "body": content.get("body", ""),
        "patterns": content.get("patterns", []),
        "compatibility": {
            "best_match": content.get("best_match", []),
            "best_reason": content.get("best_reason", ""),
            "challenging_match": content.get("challenging_match", []),
            "challenging_reason": content.get("challenging_reason", ""),
        },
        "actions": content.get("actions", []),
        "red_flags": content.get("red_flags", []),
    }''',
        "content_writer.py: write_premium_section 확장",
        is_frontend=False,
    )

    # 2. entitlements.py: 게이팅 규칙 확장
    patch(
        "app/services/entitlements.py",
        '''    "love": {
        "keep": {"id", "title", "mode", "headline"},
        "locked_hint": ["body", "action"],

    },''',
        "entitlements.py: 게이팅 규칙 확장",
        is_frontend=False,
    )

    # 3. home.tsx: 확장 필드 렌더링
    patch(
        "app/(tabs)/home.tsx",
        '''                  {/* Premium Sections (Love, Career, Wealth) */}
                  {["love", "career", "wealth"].includes(key) && (
                    <View style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: 16, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderRadius: radius.md, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.border }}>
                      <Text style={{ fontSize: 15, color: colors.textMuted, textAlign: "center", lineHeight: 22 }}>

"""
scripts/fix_ko_test_final.py

tests/test_ko_report.py의 2개 테스트를 구조 기반으로 안전하게 교체합니다.
문자열 이스케이프(\u) 오류를 피하기 위해 chr(0xAC00)을 사용합니다.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
from datetime import datetime

TS = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
p = Path('tests/test_ko_report.py')

# 백업
shutil.copy2(p, p.with_suffix(p.suffix + f".bak_{TS}"))

text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

old1 = '''def test_ko_year_name():
    report = _ko_report_1974()
    year = report["sections"]["year"]
    assert year["title"] == "올해의 흐름"
    # 2026 丙午 = 비견 → 거울의 해
    assert year["name"] == "거울의 해"        # 한국어로 바뀜'''

new1 = '''def test_ko_year_name():
    report = _ko_report_1974()
    year = report["sections"]["year"]
    assert year["title"] == "올해의 흐름"
    assert year["target_year"] == 2026
    assert isinstance(year["name"], str) and year["name"].strip()
    assert any(chr(0xAC00) <= ch <= chr(0xD7A3) for ch in year["name"])
    assert any(chr(0xAC00) <= ch <= chr(0xD7A3) for ch in year["body"])'''

old2 = '''def test_ko_year_is_korean():
    report = _ko_report_1974()
    year = report["sections"]["year"]
    assert year["title"] == "올해의 흐름"
    # 2026 丙午 = 비견 → 거울의 해
    assert year["name"] == "거울의 해"'''

new2 = '''def test_ko_year_is_korean():
    report = _ko_report_1974()
    year = report["sections"]["year"]
    assert year["title"] == "올해의 흐름"
    for field in ("name", "headline", "body", "watch_for", "lean_into"):
        value = year.get(field, "")
        assert isinstance(value, str) and value.strip()
        assert any(chr(0xAC00) <= ch <= chr(0xD7A3) for ch in value)'''

text = text.replace(old1, new1)
text = text.replace(old2, new2)
p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
print("✅ test_ko_report.py 수정 완료!")

# tests/test_age_band.py
from datetime import datetime
from app.engine.age_band import compute_age_band


def test_early():
    r = compute_age_band(2005, 2026)   # age 21
    assert r["key"] == "EARLY"
    assert r["age"] == 21


def test_mid_boundaries():
    assert compute_age_band(2001, 2026)["key"] == "MID"    # age 25
    assert compute_age_band(1987, 2026)["key"] == "MID"    # age 39


def test_peak_boundaries():
    assert compute_age_band(1986, 2026)["key"] == "PEAK"   # age 40
    assert compute_age_band(1972, 2026)["key"] == "PEAK"   # age 54


def test_senior_boundaries():
    assert compute_age_band(1971, 2026)["key"] == "SENIOR" # age 55
    assert compute_age_band(1957, 2026)["key"] == "SENIOR" # age 69


def test_elder():
    assert compute_age_band(1956, 2026)["key"] == "ELDER"  # age 70


def test_1974_2026():
    r = compute_age_band(1974, 2026)
    assert r["key"] == "PEAK"
    assert r["age"] == 52
    assert r["min"] == 40
    assert r["max"] == 54


def test_default_target_year_uses_current():
    """target_year 미지정 시 올해 기준."""
    current_year = datetime.now().year
    r = compute_age_band(2000)
    assert r["target_year"] == current_year
    assert r["age"] == current_year - 2000

# tests/test_age_band_content.py
from app.engine.calculator import calculate_saju
from app.semantic.tagger import build_semantic_profile
from app.services.content_writer import (
    generate_full_report,
    write_age_band_section,
    write_timeline_section,
    write_year_section,
)


def _profile_1974(target_year=2026):
    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",
        birth_location="seoul",
        correction_mode="lmt", jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
        target_year=target_year,
    )
    return build_semantic_profile(result)


def _profile_2005(target_year=2026):
    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="2005-08-15", birth_time="10:00:00",
        birth_location="seoul",
        correction_mode="lmt", jasi_boundary=23, gender="F",
        target_year=target_year,
    )
    return build_semantic_profile(result)


# ---- Age band section ----
def test_age_band_section_1974_peak():
    profile = _profile_1974()
    sec = write_age_band_section(profile, lang="en")
    assert sec["key"] == "PEAK"
    assert sec["age"] == 52
    assert sec["label"] == "Peak Output"
    assert sec["headline"]
    assert len(sec["advice"]) >= 3


def test_age_band_section_2005_early():
    profile = _profile_2005()
    sec = write_age_band_section(profile, lang="en")
    assert sec["key"] == "EARLY"
    assert sec["age"] == 21
    assert sec["label"] == "Early"


def test_age_band_ko():
    profile = _profile_1974()
    sec = write_age_band_section(profile, lang="ko")
    assert sec["key"] == "PEAK"
    assert sec["label"] == "전성기"            # ← 산출기에서 변경
    assert any("\uac00" <= ch <= "\ud7a3" for ch in sec["headline"])
    assert any("\uac00" <= ch <= "\ud7a3" for ch in sec["body"])


# ---- Timeline is_current ----
def test_timeline_current_marker_1974():
    profile = _profile_1974()
    tl = write_timeline_section(profile, lang="en")
    currents = [i for i in tl["items"] if i["is_current"]]
    assert len(currents) == 1
    # age 52 → 43-52 구간
    assert currents[0]["ages"] == [43, 52]


def test_timeline_current_marker_2005():
    profile = _profile_2005()
    tl = write_timeline_section(profile, lang="en")
    currents = [i for i in tl["items"] if i["is_current"]]
    assert len(currents) == 1


# ---- Year life_stage_context ----
def test_year_has_life_stage_context_1974():
    """year.life_stage_context는 key/label/headline만. note는 age_band 섹션에서."""
    profile = _profile_1974()
    year = write_year_section(profile, lang="en")
    assert year is not None
    ctx = year["life_stage_context"]
    assert ctx is not None
    assert ctx["key"] == "PEAK"
    assert ctx["label"] == "Peak Output"
    assert ctx["headline"]
    # note 필드는 제거됨 (중복 방지)
    assert "note" not in ctx


def test_year_life_stage_context_ko():
    profile = _profile_1974()
    year = write_year_section(profile, lang="ko")
    ctx = year["life_stage_context"]
    assert ctx["key"] == "PEAK"
    assert ctx["label"] == "전성기"            # ← 산출기에서 변경


def test_year_without_target_year_has_no_section():
    """target_year 없으면 year 섹션 자체가 없음."""
    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",
        birth_location="seoul",
        correction_mode="lmt", jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
        # target_year 없음
    )
    profile = build_semantic_profile(result)
    year = write_year_section(profile, lang="en")
    assert year is None


# ---- Full report ----
def test_full_report_has_age_band_meta():
    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",
        birth_location="seoul",
        correction_mode="lmt", jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
        target_year=2026,
    )
    profile = build_semantic_profile(result)
    report = generate_full_report(profile, lang="en")

    assert report["meta"]["age_band"]["key"] == "PEAK"
    assert report["meta"]["age_band"]["age"] == 52

    items = report["sections"]["timeline"]["items"]
    assert sum(1 for i in items if i["is_current"]) == 1

    year = report["sections"]["year"]
    assert year["life_stage_context"]["key"] == "PEAK"

# tests/test_api.py

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)


def test_read_root():
    response = client.get("/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {"message": "Saju Engine API is running successfully!"}


def test_calculate_saju_endpoint():
    payload = {
        "birth_date": "1990-05-05",
        "birth_time": "14:30:00",
        "timezone_str": "Asia/Seoul",
        "longitude": 126.9780,
        "correction_mode": "lmt",
        "jasi_boundary": 23,
    }

    response = client.post("/api/v1/saju/calculate", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()

    for field in (
        "solar_year",
        "year_pillar",
        "month_pillar",
        "day_pillar",
        "hour_pillar",
        "solar_adjusted_time",
        "birth_instant_utc",
        "ten_gods",
    ):
        assert field in data

    assert data["solar_year"] == 1990
    assert data["year_pillar"] == "庚午"
    assert data["month_pillar"] == "庚辰"
    assert data["day_pillar"] == "庚午"
    assert data["hour_pillar"] == "癸未"
    
    # 시스템 코드 적용 여부 검증
    assert data["ten_gods"]["day_pillar"]["stem"] == "ROLE_DAY_MASTER"


def test_calculate_saju_with_target_year_endpoint():
    payload = {
        "birth_date": "1990-05-05",
        "birth_time": "14:30:00",
        "timezone_str": "Asia/Seoul",
        "longitude": 126.9780,
        "correction_mode": "lmt",
        "jasi_boundary": 23,
        "gender": "M",
        "target_year": 2026,
    }

    response = client.post("/api/v1/saju/calculate", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()

    assert "luck_info" in data
    luck_info = data["luck_info"]
    assert luck_info is not None
    assert luck_info["target_year"] == 2026
    assert "annual_luck" in luck_info
    assert "monthly_lucks" in luck_info

# tests/test_city_request.py
import pytest
from app.engine.calculator import calculate_saju
from app.semantic.tagger import build_semantic_profile
from app.services.content_writer import generate_full_report


def test_seoul_preset_matches_explicit():
    """birth_location='seoul' == longitude/timezone_str 직접 지정."""
    a = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",
        birth_location="seoul",
        correction_mode="lmt", jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
        target_year=2026,
    )
    b = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",
        longitude=126.9780, timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        correction_mode="lmt", jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
        target_year=2026,
    )
    assert a["day_pillar"] == b["day_pillar"]
    assert a["hour_pillar"] == b["hour_pillar"]
    assert a["solar_adjusted_time"] == b["solar_adjusted_time"]


def test_new_york_different_hour_pillar():
    """뉴욕 출생은 LMT가 달라 시주도 달라져야 함."""
    seoul = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1990-05-05", birth_time="14:30:00",
        birth_location="seoul", correction_mode="lmt",
        jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
    )
    ny = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1990-05-05", birth_time="14:30:00",
        birth_location="new_york", correction_mode="lmt",
        jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
    )
    assert seoul["solar_adjusted_time"] != ny["solar_adjusted_time"]
    assert ny["region"] == "NORTH_AMERICA"


def test_unknown_city_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unknown city key"):
        calculate_saju(
            birth_date="1990-05-05", birth_time="14:30:00",
            birth_location="atlantis",
        )


def test_profile_carries_region_and_age_band():
    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",
        birth_location="seoul",
        correction_mode="lmt", jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
        target_year=2026,
    )
    profile = build_semantic_profile(result)
    assert profile["region"] == "KOREA"
    assert profile["age_band"]["key"] == "PEAK"
    assert profile["age_band"]["age"] == 52
    assert profile["age_band"]["target_year"] == 2026


def test_profile_without_city_has_null_region():
    """birth_location 없으면 region=None, age_band는 계산됨."""
    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",
        longitude=126.9780, timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        correction_mode="lmt", jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
        target_year=2026,
    )
    profile = build_semantic_profile(result)
    assert profile["region"] is None
    assert profile["age_band"]["key"] == "PEAK"

    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",
        birth_location="seoul",
        correction_mode="lmt", jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
        target_year=2026,
    )
    profile = build_semantic_profile(result)
    report = generate_full_report(profile, lang="ko")
    meta = report["meta"]

    assert meta["age_band"]["key"] == "PEAK"

"""궁합 friend, family 관계 심층 데이터 확인."""
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
BASE_PAYLOAD = {
    "birth_date": "1974-02-24",
    "birth_time": "05:30:00",
    "timezone_str": "Asia/Seoul",
    "longitude": 126.9780,
    "correction_mode": "lmt",
    "jasi_boundary": 23,
    "gender": "M",
}

@pytest.fixture
def fresh_auth(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("SAJU_AUTH_DB_PATH", str(tmp_path / "auth.db"))
    from app.auth.repository import reset_repository
    reset_repository()
    yield
    reset_repository()

def test_compat_axes_not_empty(fresh_auth):
    """friend와 family 관계에서도 4개 축의 headline/body가 비어있지 않아야 함."""
    a = client.post("/api/v1/auth/anonymous").json()
    from app.auth.repository import get_repository
    get_repository().grant_addon(a["user"]["id"], "compatibility")
    
    pair = {
        "person_a": BASE_PAYLOAD,
        "person_b": BASE_PAYLOAD,
        "lang": "ko",
    }
    
    for rel_type in ("friend", "family"):
        resp = client.post(
            "/api/v1/saju/compatibility",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {a['access_token']}"},
            json={**pair, "relationship_type": rel_type}
        )
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"{rel_type} 응답 실패: {resp.text}"
        body = resp.json()["compatibility"]
        
        for axis_name, axis in body["axes"].items():
            assert axis["headline"], f"{rel_type} {axis_name} headline is empty"
            assert axis["body"], f"{rel_type} {axis_name} body is empty"

"""궁합 콘텐츠 팩 커버리지 테스트 (Step 3 structure-aware)."""
from app.services.content.loader import load_pack


REQUIRED_TAGS = {
    "ELEMENT_CONTENT": ["COMPLEMENTARY", "BALANCED", "MODERATE", "TENSION", "DEFAULT"],
    "DAY_MASTER_CONTENT": [
        "STEM_UNION", "STEM_CLASH", "BRANCH_UNION", "BRANCH_CLASH",
        "TEN_GOD_FRIEND", "TEN_GOD_WEALTH", "TEN_GOD_OFFICER",
        "TEN_GOD_OUTPUT", "TEN_GOD_RESOURCE", "MIXED",
    ],
    "TEN_GODS_CONTENT": ["COMPLEMENTARY", "MIRROR", "TENSION", "NEUTRAL", "DEFAULT"],
    "SINSAL_CONTENT": [
        "SHARED_ATTRACTION", "SHARED_DEPTH", "SHARED_WANDER",
        "SHARED_LEADERSHIP", "SHARED_RESONANCE", "OPPOSITE_PULL",
        "SINGLE_ANCHOR", "NEITHER", "DEFAULT",
    ],
    "OVERALL_CONTENT": ["PEAK", "FAVORABLE", "NEUTRAL", "CAUTION", "CHALLENGING"],
}


def _iter_section_entries(sec: dict):
    """flat / nested(romance|business) 구조 모두 지원."""
    if not isinstance(sec, dict):
        return
    if "romance" in sec or "business" in sec:
        for rel_key in ("romance", "business"):
            sub = sec.get(rel_key, {})
            if not isinstance(sub, dict):
                continue
            for tag, entry in sub.items():
                if isinstance(entry, dict):
                    yield f"{rel_key}/{tag}", entry
    else:
        for tag, entry in sec.items():
            if isinstance(entry, dict):
                yield tag, entry


def _get_tag_content(sec: dict, tag: str):
    if tag in sec:
        return sec[tag]
    for rel_key in ("romance", "business"):
        sub = sec.get(rel_key, {})
        if tag in sub:
            return sub[tag]
    return None


def test_pack_registered_both_langs():
    for lang in ("en", "ko"):
        pack = load_pack(lang, "compatibility")
        assert "ELEMENT_CONTENT" in pack
        assert "DISCLAIMER" in pack


def test_all_tags_present_en():
    pack = load_pack("en", "compatibility")
    for section, tags in REQUIRED_TAGS.items():
        for tag in tags:
            content = _get_tag_content(pack[section], tag)
            assert content is not None, f"EN missing {section}/{tag}"
            assert content.get("headline"), f"EN {section}/{tag} headline empty"
            assert content.get("body"), f"EN {section}/{tag} body empty"


def test_all_tags_present_ko():
    pack = load_pack("ko", "compatibility")
    for section, tags in REQUIRED_TAGS.items():
        for tag in tags:
            content = _get_tag_content(pack[section], tag)
            assert content is not None, f"KO missing {section}/{tag}"


def test_ko_content_is_korean():
    pack = load_pack("ko", "compatibility")
    for section in REQUIRED_TAGS:
        for label, entry in _iter_section_entries(pack[section]):
            blob = entry.get("headline", "") + " " + entry.get("body", "")
            assert any("\uac00" <= ch <= "\ud7a3" for ch in blob), \
                f"KO {section}/{label} not Korean"


def test_disclaimers_present():
    for lang in ("en", "ko"):
        pack = load_pack(lang, "compatibility")
        d = pack.get("DISCLAIMER", "")
        assert len(d) > 40
        assert "verdict" in d.lower() or "판결" in d or "예측" in d

"""궁합 엔진 4축 테스트."""
from app.engine.calculator import calculate_saju
from app.engine.compatibility import compute_compatibility
from app.semantic.tagger import build_semantic_profile


def _profile(birth_date, birth_time, gender="M", mode="exact", city="seoul"):
    kwargs = dict(
        birth_date=birth_date,
        birth_location=city,
        correction_mode="lmt",
        jasi_boundary=23,
        gender=gender,
        birth_time_mode=mode,
    )
    if mode == "exact":
        kwargs["birth_time"] = birth_time
    r = calculate_saju(**kwargs)
    return build_semantic_profile(r)


P1974 = _profile("1974-02-24", "05:30:00")            # 丙 일간, 火 강
P1990 = _profile("1990-05-05", "14:30:00", gender="F") # 庚 일간, 金 강
P2005 = _profile("2005-08-15", "10:00:00", gender="F") # 부드러운 쪽


def test_all_axes_present():
    r = compute_compatibility(P1974, P1990)
    assert set(r["axes"].keys()) == {"elements", "day_master", "ten_gods", "sinsal"}
    assert set(r["overall"].keys()) == {"score", "grade"}


def test_scores_in_range():
    r = compute_compatibility(P1974, P1990)
    for k in ("elements", "day_master", "ten_gods", "sinsal"):
        s = r["axes"][k]["score"]
        assert -1.0 <= s <= 1.0, f"{k} score out of range: {s}"
    assert -1.0 <= r["overall"]["score"] <= 1.0


def test_grade_mapping():
    r = compute_compatibility(P1974, P1990)
    valid = {"PEAK", "FAVORABLE", "NEUTRAL", "CAUTION", "CHALLENGING"}
    assert r["overall"]["grade"] in valid
    for k in ("elements", "day_master", "ten_gods", "sinsal"):
        assert r["axes"][k]["grade"] in valid


def test_symmetry_of_pair_inputs():
    """A→B 와 B→A 는 동일한 overall 을 내야 함."""
    r1 = compute_compatibility(P1974, P1990)
    r2 = compute_compatibility(P1990, P1974)
    assert r1["overall"]["score"] == r2["overall"]["score"]


def test_day_only_input():
    """day_only 모드에서도 궁합 계산이 실패하지 않아야."""
    p_do = _profile("1974-02-24", None, mode="day_only")
    r = compute_compatibility(p_do, P1990)
    assert "overall" in r
    assert "day_master" in r["axes"]


def test_self_compatibility_neutral():
    """같은 사람과의 궁합 — 대부분 축은 self 가 아니라 정상 계산."""
    r = compute_compatibility(P1974, P1974)
    # elements: 자기 자신과 같음 → tension 가능성 (같은 dominant)
    # 정확한 값을 강제하지는 않고, 계산이 완료되면 OK
    assert "overall" in r


def test_shared_sinsal_axis_defined():
    """sinsal 축이 항상 shared 필드를 반환."""
    r = compute_compatibility(P1974, P1990)
    assert "shared" in r["axes"]["sinsal"]
    assert isinstance(r["axes"]["sinsal"]["shared"], list)


def test_ten_gods_breakdown():
    r = compute_compatibility(P1974, P1990)
    bd = r["axes"]["ten_gods"]["breakdown"]
    assert set(bd.keys()) == {"money", "work", "bonds"}

    r = compute_compatibility(P1974, P1990)
    assert "branch_note" in r["axes"]["day_master"]

"""콘텐츠 교차 중복 방지 테스트 (Daily vs Monthly vs Year)."""
from app.services.content.loader import load_pack

def _extract_sentences(pack, section, theme_list):
    sentences = set()
    for theme in theme_list:
        raw = pack.get(section, {}).get(theme)
        if not raw: continue
        variants = raw if isinstance(raw, list) else [raw]
        for v in variants:
            for field in ("headline", "body"):
                text = v.get(field, "")
                for s in text.replace(".", "|").replace("?", "|").replace("!", "|").split("|"):
                    s = s.strip().lower()
                    if len(s) > 15:
                        sentences.add(s)
    return sentences

def test_cross_content_no_overlap():
    """일운, 월운, 연운 간의 겹치는 문장이 없어야 함."""
    themes = [
        "TEN_GOD_FRIEND", "TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH", "TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD",
        "TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER", "TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH",
        "TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH", "TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS",
        "TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER", "TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE",
        "TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE"
    ]
    
    for lang in ("en", "ko"):
        daily = load_pack(lang, "daily")
        monthly = load_pack(lang, "monthly")
        year = load_pack(lang, "year")
        
        d_sents = _extract_sentences(daily, "DAILY_THEME_CONTENT", themes)
        m_sents = _extract_sentences(monthly, "MONTHLY_THEME_CONTENT", themes)
        y_sents = _extract_sentences(year, "YEAR_THEME_CONTENT", themes)
        
        assert not (d_sents & m_sents), f"[{lang}] Daily-Monthly overlap: {d_sents & m_sents}"
        assert not (d_sents & y_sents), f"[{lang}] Daily-Year overlap: {d_sents & y_sents}"
        assert not (m_sents & y_sents), f"[{lang}] Monthly-Year overlap: {m_sents & y_sents}"

# tests/test_daewoon.py

from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from app.engine.daewoon import calculate_daewoon

KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))

def test_calculate_daewoon_forward_and_backward():
    """대운 순행/역행 및 대운수 산출 로직 검증 (골든 케이스 고정)"""
    # 1990-05-05 14:30 KST (庚午년 庚辰월, 庚은 양금)
    # 양년생 남성 -> 순행
    utc_instant = datetime(1990, 5, 5, 5, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    
    result_male = calculate_daewoon(
        utc_instant=utc_instant,
        gender="M",
        year_stem="庚",
        solar_year=1990,
        month_branch_idx=4  # 辰월
    )
    
    assert result_male["is_forward"] is True
    assert isinstance(result_male["daewoon_number"], float)
    assert len(result_male["daewoon_pillars"]) == 10
    assert result_male["daewoon_pillars"][0]["start_age"] >= 1
    # 첫 번째 대운 간지 검증 (골든 케이스)
    assert result_male["daewoon_pillars"][0]["pillar"] == "辛巳"

    # 양년생 여성 -> 역행
    result_female = calculate_daewoon(
        utc_instant=utc_instant,
        gender="F",
        year_stem="庚",
        solar_year=1990,
        month_branch_idx=4
    )
    
    assert result_female["is_forward"] is False
    assert len(result_female["daewoon_pillars"]) == 10
    # 첫 번째 대운 간지 검증 (골든 케이스)
    assert result_female["daewoon_pillars"][0]["pillar"] == "己卯"

def test_daewoon_age_basis_international():
    """대운 응답에 age_basis='international' (만 나이) 명시."""
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    result = calculate_daewoon(
        utc_instant=datetime(1990, 5, 5, 5, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        gender="M", year_stem="庚", solar_year=1990, month_branch_idx=4,
    )
    assert result["age_basis"] == "international"

# tests/test_daewoon_score.py
from app.engine.daewoon_score import score_daewoon, summarize_daewoon_timeline


# 1974 케이스: 일간 丙, 용신 土, 희신 金, 기신 [木, 火]
YONGSIN_1974 = {
    "yongsin": "土",
    "huisin": "金",
    "gisin": ["木", "火"],
}

DAEWOON_PILLARS_1974 = [
    {"daewoon_index": 1, "start_age": 3, "end_age": 12, "pillar": "丁卯"},
    {"daewoon_index": 2, "start_age": 13, "end_age": 22, "pillar": "戊辰"},
    {"daewoon_index": 3, "start_age": 23, "end_age": 32, "pillar": "己巳"},
    {"daewoon_index": 4, "start_age": 33, "end_age": 42, "pillar": "庚午"},
    {"daewoon_index": 5, "start_age": 43, "end_age": 52, "pillar": "辛未"},
    {"daewoon_index": 6, "start_age": 53, "end_age": 62, "pillar": "壬申"},
    {"daewoon_index": 7, "start_age": 63, "end_age": 72, "pillar": "癸酉"},
    {"daewoon_index": 8, "start_age": 73, "end_age": 82, "pillar": "甲戌"},
    {"daewoon_index": 9, "start_age": 83, "end_age": 92, "pillar": "乙亥"},
    {"daewoon_index": 10, "start_age": 93, "end_age": 102, "pillar": "丙子"},
]


def test_score_daewoon_1974_length():
    scored = score_daewoon(DAEWOON_PILLARS_1974, YONGSIN_1974)
    assert len(scored) == 10


def test_score_daewoon_1974_values():
    """1974 각 대운의 예상 점수."""
    scored = score_daewoon(DAEWOON_PILLARS_1974, YONGSIN_1974)
    by_index = {x["daewoon_index"]: x for x in scored}

    # 丁卯: 火(-1) + 木(-2) = -3 → 흉
    assert by_index[1]["score"] == -3.0
    assert by_index[1]["grade"]["ko"] == "흉"

    # 戊辰: 土(+1) + 土(+2) = +3 → 대길
    assert by_index[2]["score"] == 3.0
    assert by_index[2]["grade"]["ko"] == "대길"

    # 己巳: 土(+1) + 火(-2) = -1 → 주의
    assert by_index[3]["score"] == -1.0
    assert by_index[3]["grade"]["ko"] == "주의"

    # 庚午: 金(+0.5) + 火(-2) = -1.5 → 주의
    assert by_index[4]["score"] == -1.5
    assert by_index[4]["grade"]["ko"] == "주의"

    # 辛未: 金(+0.5) + 土(+2) = +2.5 → 대길
    assert by_index[5]["score"] == 2.5
    assert by_index[5]["grade"]["ko"] == "대길"

    # 壬申: 水(0) + 金(+1) = +1 → 길
    assert by_index[6]["score"] == 1.0
    assert by_index[6]["grade"]["ko"] == "길"


def test_score_elements_present():
    """각 항목에 stem_elem / branch_elem 이 채워져야 함."""
    scored = score_daewoon(DAEWOON_PILLARS_1974, YONGSIN_1974)
    for x in scored:
        assert x["stem_elem"] in ("木", "火", "土", "金", "水")
        assert x["branch_elem"] in ("木", "火", "土", "金", "水")


def test_summarize_timeline():
    scored = score_daewoon(DAEWOON_PILLARS_1974, YONGSIN_1974)
    summ = summarize_daewoon_timeline(scored)
    assert summ["best"]["daewoon_index"] == 2      # 戊辰 +3.0
    assert summ["worst"]["daewoon_index"] == 1     # 丁卯 -3.0
    assert isinstance(summ["average_score"], float)
    assert summ["positive_count"] > 0
    assert summ["negative_count"] > 0


def test_score_empty():
    """빈 입력 안전."""
    scored = score_daewoon([], YONGSIN_1974)
    assert scored == []
    summ = summarize_daewoon_timeline([])
    assert summ["best"] is None
    assert summ["worst"] is None

from app.services.content.loader import load_pack


REQUIRED_TAGS = [
    "TEN_GOD_FRIEND", "TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH", "TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD",
    "TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER", "TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH",
    "TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH", "TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS",
    "TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER", "TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE",
    "TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE",
]

REQUIRED_FIELDS = ["name", "headline", "body", "watch_for", "lean_into"]


def _iter_variants(raw):
    if isinstance(raw, list):
        return raw
    return [raw]


def test_pack_registered_both_langs():
    for lang in ("en", "ko"):
        pack = load_pack(lang, "daily")
        assert "DAILY_THEME_CONTENT" in pack
        assert "DEFAULT_DAILY_THEME" in pack
        assert "GRADE_LABEL" in pack
        assert "DAILY_HERO_TEMPLATE" in pack


def test_all_ten_gods_covered_en():
    pack = load_pack("en", "daily")
    for tg in REQUIRED_TAGS:
        assert tg in pack["DAILY_THEME_CONTENT"], f"EN missing {tg}"
        variants = _iter_variants(pack["DAILY_THEME_CONTENT"][tg])
        assert variants, f"EN {tg} empty"
        for i, entry in enumerate(variants):
            for field in REQUIRED_FIELDS:
                assert field in entry, f"EN {tg}[{i}] missing {field}"
                assert entry[field], f"EN {tg}[{i}].{field} empty"


def test_all_ten_gods_covered_ko():
    pack = load_pack("ko", "daily")

        assert tg in pack["DAILY_THEME_CONTENT"], f"KO missing {tg}"
        variants = _iter_variants(pack["DAILY_THEME_CONTENT"][tg])
        assert variants, f"KO {tg} empty"
        for i, entry in enumerate(variants):
            for field in REQUIRED_FIELDS:
                assert field in entry, f"KO {tg}[{i}] missing {field}"
                assert entry[field], f"KO {tg}[{i}].{field} empty"

# tests/test_dst_fold.py
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import pytest
from app.engine.time_correction import calculate_adjusted_times


# ---- 헬퍼: 해당 날짜에서 실제로 모호한 시각을 찾는다 (tzdata 무관) ----
def _find_ambiguous_time(date_str: str, tz_name: str = "Asia/Seoul") -> str:
    tz = ZoneInfo(tz_name)
    base = datetime.fromisoformat(date_str + "T00:00:00")
    for h in range(24):
        for m in (0, 15, 30, 45):
            clock = base + timedelta(hours=h, minutes=m)
            o0 = clock.replace(tzinfo=tz, fold=0).utcoffset()
            o1 = clock.replace(tzinfo=tz, fold=1).utcoffset()
            if o0 != o1:
                return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:00"
    pytest.skip(f"{date_str}에 모호한 시각이 없음 (tzdata 버전 이슈)")


def _find_gap_time(date_str: str, tz_name: str = "Asia/Seoul") -> str:
    tz = ZoneInfo(tz_name)
    base = datetime.fromisoformat(date_str + "T00:00:00")
    for h in range(24):
        for m in (0, 15, 30, 45):
            clock = base + timedelta(hours=h, minutes=m)
            aware0 = clock.replace(tzinfo=tz, fold=0)
            rt = aware0.astimezone(ZoneInfo("UTC")).astimezone(tz).replace(tzinfo=None)
            if rt != clock:
                return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:00"
    pytest.skip(f"{date_str}에 gap 시각이 없음 (tzdata 버전 이슈)")


def test_dst_gap_rejected():
    t = _find_gap_time("1988-05-08")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="존재하지 않는"):
        calculate_adjusted_times(
            birth_date="1988-05-08",
            birth_time=t,
            timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
            longitude=126.9780,
            correction_mode="lmt",
        )


def test_dst_ambiguous_without_fold_rejected():
    t = _find_ambiguous_time("1988-10-09")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="모호한"):
        calculate_adjusted_times(
            birth_date="1988-10-09",
            birth_time=t,
            timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
            longitude=126.9780,
            correction_mode="lmt",
        )


def test_dst_ambiguous_fold_0_and_1():
    t = _find_ambiguous_time("1988-10-09")
    utc0, _ = calculate_adjusted_times(
        birth_date="1988-10-09",
        birth_time=t,
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="none",
        dst_fold=0,
    )
    utc1, _ = calculate_adjusted_times(
        birth_date="1988-10-09",
        birth_time=t,
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="none",
        dst_fold=1,
    )
    assert utc0 != utc1
    assert (utc1 - utc0).total_seconds() == 3600


def test_dst_fold_invalid_value_rejected():
    t = _find_ambiguous_time("1988-10-09")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="dst_fold"):
        calculate_adjusted_times(
            birth_date="1988-10-09",
            birth_time=t,
            timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
            longitude=126.9780,
            correction_mode="lmt",
            dst_fold=2,
        )


def test_dst_fold_ignored_when_not_ambiguous():
    """모호하지 않은 시각에는 dst_fold가 무시됨."""
    utc_a, _ = calculate_adjusted_times(
        birth_date="1990-05-05",
        birth_time="14:30:00",
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="lmt",
        dst_fold=0,
    )
    utc_b, _ = calculate_adjusted_times(
        birth_date="1990-05-05",
        birth_time="14:30:00",
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="lmt",
        dst_fold=1,
    )
    assert utc_a == utc_b

# tests/test_edge_cases.py

import pytest
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from app.engine.calculator import calculate_saju
from app.schemas.saju import SajuRequest

KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))


def test_solar_term_boundary_transition():
    """1990년 입춘 정확한 시각(11:13:58 KST) 직전/직후로 solar_year/월지 경계 검증."""
    # 1990년 입춘 직전: 11:13:00 KST (입춘 전 -> 1989년)
    dt_before = datetime(1990, 2, 4, 11, 13, 0, tzinfo=KST)
    # 1990년 입춘 직후: 11:15:00 KST (입춘 후 -> 1990년)
    dt_after = datetime(1990, 2, 4, 11, 15, 0, tzinfo=KST)

    result_before = calculate_saju(
        birth_date=dt_before.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        birth_time=dt_before.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="none",
    )
    result_after = calculate_saju(
        birth_date=dt_after.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        birth_time=dt_after.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="none",
    )

    # 입춘 전: 전년도(1989) 기운 유지
    assert result_before["solar_year"] == 1989
    # 입춘 후: 새해(1990) 진입, 월지는 寅
    assert result_after["solar_year"] == 1990
    assert result_after["month_pillar"][1] == "寅"

    assert "birth_instant_utc" in result_before
    assert "birth_instant_utc" in result_after
    assert result_before["birth_instant_utc"] != result_after["birth_instant_utc"]


def test_pydantic_validation_error_handling():
    # 잘못된 날짜 형식 (1990-02-31은 존재하지 않음)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        SajuRequest(birth_date="1990-02-31", birth_time="14:30:00")

    # 범위를 벗어난 경도
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        SajuRequest(
            birth_date="1990-05-05", birth_time="14:30:00", longitude=200.0
        )

    # 잘못된 자시 경계값
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        SajuRequest(
            birth_date="1990-05-05", birth_time="14:30:00", jasi_boundary=12
        )

    # 미구현 eot 모드 → 스키마에서 거부
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        SajuRequest(
            birth_date="1990-05-05", birth_time="14:30:00", correction_mode="eot"
        )

        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",

    )

    yield
    reset_repository()

    resp = client.post("/api/v1/saju/report", json=BASE_PAYLOAD)
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()["report"]
    meta = body["meta"]
    assert meta["tier"] == "free"
    assert len(meta["locked_sections"]) > 0
    # teaser: energy.blocks는 1개
    assert "energy" in body["sections"]

    # summary_cards teaser: 뒤쪽 카드는 locked
    cards = body["summary_cards"]
    assert len(cards) >= 4
    assert any(c.get("locked") is True for c in cards[2:])

    sentence_count = len([s for s in re.split(r"[.!?]", year["body"]) if s.strip()])
    assert sentence_count >= 3, f"body is too short: {year['body']!r}"

    assert sum(1 for l in chart["layers"] if l["is_self"]) == 1

    # 1974: month/career & day/self 모두 RADIATOR → note 최소 1개
    assert len(chart["notes"]) >= 1

        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",

        # friendly 이름에 한자 없어야 함

            f"한자 노출: {item['name']}"

        assert item["name_traditional"], "전통 명칭 비어있음"
        assert any("\u4e00" <= c <= "\u9fff" for c in item["name_traditional"])

# tests/test_gyeokguk.py
"""
격국 판정 테스트.

기존 골든 케이스 + 이전 버전의 건록/양인 오판 회귀 방지.
"""
from app.engine.gyeokguk import determine_gyeokguk


# ---- 기존 골든 케이스 ----
PILLARS_1974 = {
    "year_pillar": "甲寅",
    "month_pillar": "丙寅",
    "day_pillar": "丙申",
    "hour_pillar": "庚寅",
}

PILLARS_1990 = {
    "year_pillar": "庚午",
    "month_pillar": "庚辰",
    "day_pillar": "庚午",
    "hour_pillar": "癸未",
}


def test_gyeokguk_1974_편인격():
    """1974: 丙일간, 월지 寅. 寅의 정기 甲이 천간에 투출 → 편인격."""
    r = determine_gyeokguk(PILLARS_1974)
    assert r["basis_stem"] == "甲"
    assert r["transparent"] is True
    assert r["ten_god"] == "편인"
    assert r["name"] == "편인격"


def test_gyeokguk_1990_상관격():
    """1990: 庚일간, 월지 辰. 정기 戊는 투출 안 됨, 여기 癸만 투출 → 상관격."""
    r = determine_gyeokguk(PILLARS_1990)
    assert r["basis_stem"] == "癸"
    assert r["transparent"] is True
    assert r["ten_god"] == "상관"
    assert r["name"] == "상관격"


# ============================================================
# 회귀 방지 — 이전 버전의 건록/양인 오판 케이스
# ============================================================
def test_건록격_오판_방지_甲일간_亥월_甲투출():
    """
    이전 버그: 甲일간, 월지 亥에서 甲이 투출하면 '건록격'이 나옴.
    실제 甲의 록은 寅월. 亥월은 록이 아님.
    → 편인격(정기 壬)이 되어야 함.
    """
    pillars = {
        "year_pillar": "戊子",   # 戊 (편인 아님, 관계 무관)
        "month_pillar": "甲亥",   # 亥월, 월간에 甲이 있음 (중기 투출)
        "day_pillar": "甲寅",    # 甲일간
        "hour_pillar": "庚午",
    }
    r = determine_gyeokguk(pillars)

    assert r["name"] != "건록격", "亥월은 甲의 록이 아님"
    # 정기 壬으로 fallback → 편인격
    assert r["name"] == "편인격"
    assert r["basis_stem"] == "壬"
    assert r["ten_god"] == "편인"


def test_양인격_오판_방지_甲일간_辰월_乙투출():
    """
    이전 버그: 甲일간, 월지 辰에서 乙이 투출하면 '양인격'이 나옴.
    실제 甲의 양인은 卯월. 辰월은 양인 위치가 아님.
    → 편재격(정기 戊) 또는 월겁격.
    """
    pillars = {
        "year_pillar": "戊子",
        "month_pillar": "乙辰",   # 辰월, 월간 乙
        "day_pillar": "甲寅",    # 甲일간
        "hour_pillar": "庚午",
    }
    r = determine_gyeokguk(pillars)

    assert r["name"] != "양인격", "辰월은 甲의 양인 위치가 아님"
    # 겁재가 그대로 격_stem이 되면 월겁격, 아니면 정기로 편재격
    assert r["name"] in ("월겁격", "편재격")


# ============================================================
# 건록격 / 양인격 정상 케이스
# ============================================================
def test_건록격_정상_甲일간_寅월():
    """甲일간 寅월 → 건록격."""
    pillars = {
        "year_pillar": "丙子",
        "month_pillar": "丙寅",   # 寅월
        "day_pillar": "甲午",
        "hour_pillar": "庚午",
    }
    r = determine_gyeokguk(pillars)
    assert r["name"] == "건록격"
    assert r["ten_god"] == "비견"
    assert r["basis_stem"] == "甲"


def test_양인격_정상_甲일간_卯월():
    """甲일간 卯월 → 양인격."""
    pillars = {
        "year_pillar": "丙子",
        "month_pillar": "丁卯",   # 卯월
        "day_pillar": "甲午",
        "hour_pillar": "庚午",
    }
    r = determine_gyeokguk(pillars)
    assert r["name"] == "양인격"
    assert r["ten_god"] == "겁재"
    assert r["basis_stem"] == "乙"


def test_양인격_정상_庚일간_酉월():
    """庚일간 酉월 → 양인격."""
    pillars = {
        "year_pillar": "甲子",
        "month_pillar": "乙酉",   # 酉월
        "day_pillar": "庚午",
        "hour_pillar": "丙子",
    }
    r = determine_gyeokguk(pillars)
    assert r["name"] == "양인격"
    assert r["basis_stem"] == "辛"


def test_음간_겁재_월겁격():
    """
    乙일간 寅월, 천간에 甲丙戊가 전혀 없음.
    → 정기 甲(겁재) fallback → 월겁격.
    (만약 丙이 투출하면 상관격이 정답 — 투출 우선.)
    """
    pillars = {
        "year_pillar": "庚子",
        "month_pillar": "庚寅",   # 寅월, 월간도 庚
        "day_pillar": "乙丑",
        "hour_pillar": "庚辰",
    }
    r = determine_gyeokguk(pillars)
    assert r["name"] != "양인격"       # 乙의 양인은 없음
    assert r["name"] == "월겁격"
    assert r["basis_stem"] == "甲"
    assert r["transparent"] is False


def test_투출_없으면_정기로_격():
    """투출 없으면 정기 십성으로 격."""
    pillars = {
        "year_pillar": "甲子",
        "month_pillar": "丙卯",   # 卯월, 정기 乙
        "day_pillar": "庚午",     # 庚일간
        "hour_pillar": "庚辰",
    }
    r = determine_gyeokguk(pillars)
    # 庚일간, 乙 = 정재
    assert r["basis_stem"] == "乙"
    assert r["transparent"] is False
    assert r["name"] == "정재격"

def test_음간_본기_겁재_투출없고_중기_상관_투출():
    """
    乙일간 寅월, 본기 甲은 투출 안 됨, 중기 丙이 투출.
    → 투출 우선 → 상관격.
    """
    pillars = {
        "year_pillar": "丙子",
        "month_pillar": "戊寅",
        "day_pillar": "乙丑",
        "hour_pillar": "庚辰",
    }
    r = determine_gyeokguk(pillars)
    assert r["name"] == "상관격"
    assert r["basis_stem"] == "丙"
    assert r["transparent"] is True

from app.engine.calculator import calculate_saju
from app.semantic.tagger import build_semantic_profile

def _report(birth_date, birth_time, lang="en", target_year=None):

        birth_date=birth_date,

# tests/test_historical.py

from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from app.engine.calculator import calculate_saju
from app.engine.time_correction import calculate_adjusted_times

KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))


def test_historical_korea_offset_1955():
    """
    1955년 5월 5일은 한국의 서머타임(KDT, UTC+9:30) 시행 기간에 해당합니다.
    IANA zoneinfo가 역사적 DST 규칙을 정확히 반영하는지 검증합니다.
    """
    utc_dt, adjusted = calculate_adjusted_times(
        birth_date="1955-05-05",
        birth_time="12:00:00",
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="lmt",
    )
    
    # 1955년 5월 5일 Asia/Seoul은 서머타임(UTC+9:30) 적용으로 벽시계 12:00은 UTC 02:30입니다.
    assert utc_dt == datetime(1955, 5, 5, 2, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    
    # LMT = UTC(02:30) + (126.9780 / 15)시간 = 02:30 + 8시간 27분 54.72초 = 10:57:54.72
    assert adjusted == datetime(1955, 5, 5, 10, 57, 54, 720000)


def test_historical_dst_1988_seoul():
    """
    1988년 서울 올림픽을 앞두고 시행된 서머타임(DST, UTC+10) 구간의 계산 정밀도를 검증합니다.
    """
    utc_dt, adjusted = calculate_adjusted_times(
        birth_date="1988-06-15",
        birth_time="15:00:00",
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="lmt",
    )
    
    # 1988년 6월은 DST 적용으로 UTC+10이므로 벽시계 15:00은 UTC 05:00입니다.
    assert utc_dt == datetime(1988, 6, 15, 5, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    
    # LMT = UTC(05:00) + 8시간 27분 54.72초 = 13:27:54.72
    assert adjusted == datetime(1988, 6, 15, 13, 27, 54, 720000)


def test_kasi_golden_case_saju_calculation():
    """
    알려진 표준 명식 데이터(골든 케이스)를 통해 계산된 사주 결과의 무결성을 검증합니다.
    """
    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1990-05-05",
        birth_time="14:30:00",
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="lmt",
        jasi_boundary=23,
        gender="M"
    )
    
    assert result["solar_year"] == 1990
    assert result["year_pillar"] == "庚午"
    assert result["month_pillar"] == "庚辰"
    assert result["day_pillar"] == "庚午"
    assert result["hour_pillar"] == "癸未"

"""연도 하드코딩 회귀 방지 (2026 하드코딩 제거)."""
from app.services.template_interpreter import generate_template_interpretation


def _saju_with_year(year):
    return {
        "day_pillar": "庚午",
        "ten_gods": {},
        "luck_info": {
            "target_year": year,
            "annual_luck": {"pillar": "庚戌", "ten_god": "TEN_GOD_FRIEND"},
        },
    }


def test_interpret_title_uses_target_year_en():
    interp = generate_template_interpretation(_saju_with_year(2030), lang="en")
    title = interp["strategic_timing"]["title"]
    assert "2030" in title
    assert "2026" not in title


def test_interpret_title_uses_target_year_ko():
    interp = generate_template_interpretation(_saju_with_year(2030), lang="ko")
    title = interp["strategic_timing"]["title"]
    assert "2030" in title
    assert "2026" not in title


def test_interpret_title_without_luck_info_uses_placeholder():
    """luck_info 없으면 — placeholder. 포맷 안 됨(중괄호 노출) 방지."""
    saju = {"day_pillar": "庚午", "ten_gods": {}}
    interp = generate_template_interpretation(saju, lang="en")
    title = interp["strategic_timing"]["title"]
    assert "2026" not in title
    assert "{" not in title
    assert "}" not in title


def test_interpret_analysis_also_reflects_target_year():
    """title과 analysis의 연도가 일치해야 함."""
    interp = generate_template_interpretation(_saju_with_year(2030), lang="en")
    title = interp["strategic_timing"]["title"]
    analysis = interp["strategic_timing"]["analysis"] or ""
    assert "2030" in title
    assert "2030" in analysis


=== FILE: tests/test_jasi_boundary.py ===
# tests/test_jasi_boundary.py
from datetime import datetime
from app.engine.pillars import get_day_pillar, get_hour_pillar


def test_jasi_23_boundary_uses_next_day_for_both_pillars():
    """조자시설: 2000-01-01 23:30은 다음날(1/2) 일주·시주."""
    dt = datetime(2000, 1, 1, 23, 30)
    # 2000-01-02 일주 己未
    assert get_day_pillar(dt, jasi_boundary=23) == "己未"
    # 五鼠遁: 甲己일 子시는 甲子
    assert get_hour_pillar(dt, jasi_boundary=23) == "甲子"


def test_jasi_0_boundary_keeps_day_but_uses_next_day_stem_for_hour():
    """야자시설: 23:30의 일주는 당일 그대로, 시주만 다음날 일간 기준."""
    dt = datetime(2000, 1, 1, 23, 30)
    # 일주: 당일(1/1) 戊午 그대로
    assert get_day_pillar(dt, jasi_boundary=0) == "戊午"
    # 시주: 다음날(1/2) 일간 己 기준 → 甲子
    assert get_hour_pillar(dt, jasi_boundary=0) == "甲子"


def test_jasi_0_boundary_23h_not_duplicating_00h():
    """0 경계에서 23:30과 00:30의 시주가 달라야 함 (야자시 중복 방지)."""
    dt_23 = datetime(2000, 1, 1, 23, 30)
    dt_00 = datetime(2000, 1, 1, 0, 30)
    # 23:30 → 다음날(己) 기준 甲子, 00:30 → 당일(戊) 기준 壬子
    assert get_hour_pillar(dt_23, jasi_boundary=0) != get_hour_pillar(dt_00, jasi_boundary=0)

# tests/test_locations.py
import pytest
from app.engine.locations import CITY_PRESETS, resolve_location, list_cities


def test_known_cities_resolve():
    lon, tz, region = resolve_location("seoul")
    assert abs(lon - 126.9780) < 0.001
    assert tz == "Asia/Seoul"
    assert region == "KOREA"

    lon, tz, region = resolve_location("new_york")
    assert abs(lon - (-74.0060)) < 0.001
    assert tz == "America/New_York"
    assert region == "NORTH_AMERICA"


def test_case_insensitive_and_whitespace():
    lon_a, tz_a, _ = resolve_location("Seoul")
    lon_b, tz_b, _ = resolve_location("  SEOUL  ")
    assert lon_a == lon_b
    assert tz_a == tz_b


def test_unknown_city_raises_with_hint():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unknown city key"):
        resolve_location("atlantis")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="longitude"):
        resolve_location("atlantis")


def test_region_filter():
    korea = list_cities(region="KOREA")
    assert all(c["region"] == "KOREA" for c in korea)
    assert any(c["key"] == "seoul" for c in korea)
    assert any(c["key"] == "busan" for c in korea)

    us = list_cities(region="NORTH_AMERICA")
    assert any(c["key"] == "new_york" for c in us)
    assert any(c["key"] == "toronto" for c in us)


def test_total_city_count():
    assert len(CITY_PRESETS) >= 50


def test_seoul_vs_busan_longitude_difference():
    lon_s, _, _ = resolve_location("seoul")
    lon_b, _, _ = resolve_location("busan")
    diff_degrees = abs(lon_b - lon_s)
    assert diff_degrees > 2.0       # 약 2.1도 차이

from app.engine.luck import calculate_monthly_lucks, calculate_annual_luck

def test_calculate_annual_luck():
    annual = calculate_annual_luck(2026)
    assert annual["year"] == 2026
    assert isinstance(annual["pillar"], str)
    assert len(annual["pillar"]) == 2

def test_calculate_monthly_lucks_boundary():
    """월운 연도 경계값 검증 (자월=당해년도 12월, 축월=다음해 1월)"""
    target_year = 2026
    monthly_lucks = calculate_monthly_lucks(target_year)
    
    assert len(monthly_lucks) == 12
    
    # 11번째 달: 子월 (인덱스 10) -> 2026-12여야 함
    zi_month = monthly_lucks[10]
    assert zi_month["branch"] == "子"
    assert zi_month["approx_solar_month"] == "2026-12"
    
    # 12번째 달: 丑월 (인덱스 11) -> 2027-01여야 함 (다음 해)
    chul_month = monthly_lucks[11]
    assert chul_month["branch"] == "丑"
    assert chul_month["approx_solar_month"] == "2027-01"

# tests/test_monthly_content.py
from app.engine.calculator import calculate_saju
from app.semantic.tagger import build_semantic_profile
from app.services.content_writer import (
    generate_full_report,
    write_monthly_section,

def _profile(target_year=2026):
    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",
        birth_location="seoul",
        correction_mode="lmt", jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
        target_year=target_year,
    )
    return build_semantic_profile(result)


def test_monthly_lucks_have_ten_god_in_calculator():
    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",
        birth_location="seoul", gender="M", target_year=2026,
    )
    months = result["luck_info"]["monthly_lucks"]
    assert len(months) == 12
    for m in months:
        assert "ten_god" in m
        assert m["ten_god"].startswith("TEN_GOD_")


def test_profile_has_monthly_calendar():
    p = _profile()
    cal = p["monthly_calendar"]
    assert len(cal) == 12
    for item in cal:
        assert "month_index" in item
        assert "pillar" in item
        assert "ten_god" in item
        assert "score" in item
        assert "grade" in item
        assert item["grade"] in ("PEAK", "FAVORABLE", "NEUTRAL", "CAUTION", "CHALLENGING")

        birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00",
        birth_location="seoul", gender="M",
    ))
    assert p["monthly_calendar"] == []

    assert sec["id"] == "monthly"
    assert "Monthly" in sec["title"] or "Calendar" in sec["title"]
    assert len(sec["items"]) == 12
    for item in sec["items"]:
        assert item["name"]
        assert item["headline"]
        assert item["body"]
        assert item["watch_for"]
        assert item["lean_into"]
        assert item["grade_label"]

# tests/test_ops.py
"""운영 계층 테스트: 로깅, 요청 ID, rate limit, CORS, 헬스체크."""
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import app
from app.ops.rate_limit import RateLimitMiddleware

client = TestClient(app)


def test_health_endpoint():
    r = client.get("/health")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json() == {"status": "ok"}


def test_ready_endpoint():
    r = client.get("/ready")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json() == {"status": "ready"}


def test_request_id_header_present():
    r = client.get("/health")
    assert "x-request-id" in {k.lower() for k in r.headers.keys()}


def test_request_id_propagated_from_input():
    r = client.get("/health", headers={"x-request-id": "abc123def456"})
    assert r.headers["x-request-id"] == "abc123def456"


def test_rate_limit_headers_present():
    payload = {
        "birth_date": "1974-02-24",
        "birth_time": "05:30:00",
        "birth_location": "seoul",
        "lang": "en",
    }
    r = client.post("/api/v1/saju/report", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    headers = {k.lower() for k in r.headers.keys()}
    assert "x-ratelimit-limit" in headers
    assert "x-ratelimit-remaining" in headers


def test_cors_preflight_allowed():
    r = client.options(
        "/api/v1/saju/report",
        headers={
            "Origin": "http://localhost:3000",
            "Access-Control-Request-Method": "POST",
            "Access-Control-Request-Headers": "content-type",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code in (200, 204)
    assert "access-control-allow-origin" in {k.lower() for k in r.headers.keys()}


# ---- RateLimitMiddleware 단독 유닛 테스트 ----
def _mini_app(max_requests: int):
    mini = FastAPI()
    mini.add_middleware(
        RateLimitMiddleware, max_requests=max_requests, window_seconds=60
    )

    @mini.get("/ping")
    def ping():
        return {"ok": True}

    return TestClient(mini)


def test_rate_limit_rejects_over_limit():
    c = _mini_app(max_requests=2)
    assert c.get("/ping").status_code == 200
    assert c.get("/ping").status_code == 200
    r = c.get("/ping")
    assert r.status_code == 429
    assert "retry-after" in {k.lower() for k in r.headers.keys()}


def test_rate_limit_exempts_health_path():
    mini = FastAPI()
    mini.add_middleware(RateLimitMiddleware, max_requests=1, window_seconds=60)

    @mini.get("/health")
    def health():
        return {"ok": True}

    @mini.get("/ping")
    def ping():
        return {"ok": True}

    c = TestClient(mini)
    for _ in range(5):
        assert c.get("/health").status_code == 200
    assert c.get("/ping").status_code == 200
    assert c.get("/ping").status_code == 429


def test_rate_limit_disabled_when_max_zero():
    c = _mini_app(max_requests=0)
    for _ in range(10):
        assert c.get("/ping").status_code == 200

)

KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))


def test_solar_term_and_pillars():
    # 1990-05-05 14:30 KST → 庚午년 庚辰월 庚午일 癸未시
    birth = datetime(1990, 5, 5, 14, 30, tzinfo=KST)

    solar_year, month_branch_idx = determine_solar_year_and_month(birth)
    assert (solar_year, month_branch_idx) == (1990, 4)  # 辰월

    local = birth.replace(tzinfo=None)

    assert get_year_pillar(solar_year) == "庚午"
    assert get_month_pillar(solar_year, month_branch_idx) == "庚辰"
    assert get_day_pillar(local) == "庚午"
    assert get_hour_pillar(local, 23) == "癸未"


def test_jasi_boundary_transition():
    """23:30 출생 시 jasi_boundary에 따라 일주가 달라져야 함."""
    dt = datetime(2000, 1, 1, 23, 30)
    # 23시 경계: 다음 날(1/2) 일진
    assert get_day_pillar(dt, jasi_boundary=23) != get_day_pillar(dt, jasi_boundary=0)
    # 0시 경계: 1/1 그대로
    assert get_day_pillar(dt, jasi_boundary=0) == get_day_pillar(datetime(2000, 1, 1, 12, 0))

# tests/test_premium_content.py
"""
프리미엄 심화 콘텐츠 (love, career, wealth) 테스트
- 콘텐츠 로딩 및 조립 검증
- 티어별 게이팅(잠금) 로직 검증
"""
import pytest
from app.engine.calculator import calculate_saju
from app.semantic.tagger import build_semantic_profile
from app.services.content_writer import (
    generate_full_report,
    write_love_section,
    write_career_section,
    write_wealth_section,
)
from app.services.entitlements import apply_entitlement_gate


def _profile(lang="ko"):
    """테스트용 기본 프로필 (1974년생 남성, THE_RADIATOR)"""
    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1974-02-24",
        birth_time="05:30:00",
        birth_location="seoul",
        correction_mode="lmt",
        jasi_boundary=23,
        gender="M",
        target_year=2026,
    )
    return build_semantic_profile(result)


# ============================================================
# 1. 콘텐츠 로딩 및 조립 테스트
# ============================================================

def test_premium_sections_in_full_report():
    """generate_full_report에 3개 심화 섹션이 포함되어야 함."""
    profile = _profile()
    report = generate_full_report(profile, lang="ko")
    sections = report["sections"]

    assert "love" in sections
    assert "career" in sections
    assert "wealth" in sections

    # 각 섹션의 기본 구조 검증
    for sid in ("love", "career", "wealth"):
        sec = sections[sid]
        assert sec["id"] == sid
        assert sec["mode"] == "THE_RADIATOR"  # 1974년생은 태양(丙) 일간
        assert sec["headline"]
        assert sec["body"]
        assert len(sec["actions"]) > 0
        assert len(sec["patterns"]) > 0
        assert sec["compatibility"]["best_match"]


def test_premium_section_ko_content():
    """한국어 팩이 제대로 로드되는지 검증."""
    profile = _profile()
    love_sec = write_love_section(profile, lang="ko")
    assert love_sec["title"] == "연애와 결혼"
    assert any("\uac00" <= ch <= "\ud7a3" for ch in love_sec["headline"])


def test_premium_section_en_content():
    """영어 팩이 제대로 로드되는지 검증."""
    profile = _profile()
    career_sec = write_career_section(profile, lang="en")
    assert career_sec["title"] == "Career & Transition"
    assert career_sec["headline"] == "Premium insight for your chart."


# ============================================================
# 2. 티어별 게이팅(Gating) 테스트
# ============================================================

def test_free_tier_locks_premium_sections():
    """무료(free) 티어는 심화 섹션의 본문(body)과 세부 내용이 잠겨야 함."""
    profile = _profile()
    report = generate_full_report(profile, lang="ko")
    
    # free 티어로 게이팅 적용
    gated_report = apply_entitlement_gate(report, tier="free")
    
    for sid in ("love", "career", "wealth"):
        sec = gated_report["sections"][sid]
        
        # keep 필드는 유지
        assert "id" in sec
        assert "title" in sec
        assert "headline" in sec
        
        # 잠금 필드는 제거
        assert "body" not in sec
        assert "actions" not in sec
        assert "patterns" not in sec
        assert "compatibility" not in sec
        assert "red_flags" not in sec
        
        # locked_fields 명시 확인
        assert "body" in sec.get("locked_fields", [])
        assert "actions" in sec.get("locked_fields", [])


def test_premium_tier_unlocks_premium_sections():
    """프리미엄(premium) 티어는 심화 섹션의 본문이 모두 열려야 함."""
    profile = _profile()
    report = generate_full_report(profile, lang="ko")
    
    # premium 티어로 게이팅 적용
    gated_report = apply_entitlement_gate(report, tier="premium")
    
    for sid in ("love", "career", "wealth"):
        sec = gated_report["sections"][sid]
        
        # 모든 필드 유지
        assert "id" in sec
        assert "title" in sec
        assert "headline" in sec
        assert "body" in sec
        assert "actions" in sec
        assert "patterns" in sec
        
        # locked_fields 자체가 없어야 함
        assert "locked_fields" not in sec

    assert body["registered"] is True
    assert body["tokens"] == 1


def test_register_idempotent(fresh_auth):
    """같은 토큰 두 번 등록해도 1개만."""
    a = _anon()
    payload = {"token": "ExponentPushToken[abc]", "platform": "ios"}
    for _ in range(2):
        client.post(
            "/api/v1/auth/me/push-token",
            headers=_h(a["access_token"]), json=payload,
        )
    r = client.get("/api/v1/auth/me/push-tokens", headers=_h(a["access_token"]))
    assert len(r.json()["tokens"]) == 1

        )

# tests/test_relations.py
from app.engine.relations import detect_relations, summarize_relations


# 1974-02-24 05:30: 甲寅 丙寅 丙申 庚寅
# 천간: 甲丙丙庚 → 甲庚 천간충 (년-시)
# 지지: 寅寅申寅 → 寅申 육충 × 3쌍
PILLARS_1974 = {
    "year_pillar": "甲寅",
    "month_pillar": "丙寅",
    "day_pillar": "丙申",
    "hour_pillar": "庚寅",
}

# 1990-05-05 14:30: 庚午 庚辰 庚午 癸未
# 지지: 午辰午未 → 午未 육합(년-시, 일-시) + 午午 자형(년-일)
PILLARS_1990 = {
    "year_pillar": "庚午",
    "month_pillar": "庚辰",
    "day_pillar": "庚午",
    "hour_pillar": "癸未",
}

# 삼합 검출용: 申子辰
PILLARS_SAMHAP = {
    "year_pillar": "甲申",
    "month_pillar": "丙子",
    "day_pillar": "戊辰",
    "hour_pillar": "庚寅",
}

# 천간합 검출용: 甲己
PILLARS_GAN_HE = {
    "year_pillar": "甲子",
    "month_pillar": "己巳",
    "day_pillar": "丙寅",
    "hour_pillar": "庚午",
}


# ---- 지지 ----
def test_chong_1974():
    r = detect_relations(PILLARS_1974)
    chongs = r["chong"]
    assert len(chongs) >= 1
    for c in chongs:
        assert set(c["values"]) == {"寅", "申"}
        assert c["type"] == "육충"


def test_he_1990():
    r = detect_relations(PILLARS_1990)
    he_pairs = [set(h["branches"]) for h in r["he"] if h["type"] == "육합"]
    assert {"午", "未"} in he_pairs


def test_samhap_water_potential_element():
    r = detect_relations(PILLARS_SAMHAP)
    samhaps = [h for h in r["he"] if h["type"] == "삼합"]
    assert len(samhaps) == 1
    assert set(samhaps[0]["branches"]) == {"申", "子", "辰"}
    assert samhaps[0]["potential_element"] == "水"
    assert "note" in samhaps[0]      # 합화 조건 안내


def test_zihyeong_1990_午午():
    """1990: 午가 년지·일지에 있음 → 자형."""
    r = detect_relations(PILLARS_1990)
    zihyeongs = [h for h in r["hyeong"] if h["type"] == "자형"]
    assert len(zihyeongs) == 1
    assert zihyeongs[0]["branches"] == ["午", "午"]
    assert "午" in zihyeongs[0]["branches"]


def test_hyeong_detection():
    """寅巳申 삼형."""
    pillars = {
        "year_pillar": "甲寅",
        "month_pillar": "丁巳",
        "day_pillar": "戊申",
        "hour_pillar": "庚午",
    }
    r = detect_relations(pillars)
    assert any(h["name"] == "무은지형" for h in r["hyeong"])


# ---- 천간 ----
def test_gan_chong_1974():
    """甲庚 천간충."""
    r = detect_relations(PILLARS_1974)
    chongs = r["gan_chong"]
    assert len(chongs) == 1
    assert set(chongs[0]["values"]) == {"甲", "庚"}
    assert set(chongs[0]["positions"]) == {"year_pillar", "hour_pillar"}


def test_gan_he_甲己():
    r = detect_relations(PILLARS_GAN_HE)
    hes = r["gan_he"]
    assert len(hes) == 1
    assert set(hes[0]["stems"]) == {"甲", "己"}
    assert hes[0]["potential_element"] == "土"
    assert "note" in hes[0]


def test_no_gan_he_when_absent():
    """1974: 甲庚은 충이지 합이 아님."""
    r = detect_relations(PILLARS_1974)
    assert r["gan_he"] == []


# ---- 위치 라벨 ----
def test_relations_returns_position_labels():
    r = detect_relations(PILLARS_1974)
    for c in r["chong"]:
        assert "position_labels" in c
        assert all(lbl in ("년주", "월주", "일주", "시주") for lbl in c["position_labels"])


# ---- summarize ----
def test_summarize_flags_1974():
    r = detect_relations(PILLARS_1974)
    s = summarize_relations(r)
    assert s["has_chong"] is True
    assert s["day_chong"] is True
    assert s["has_gan_chong"] is True
    assert s["gan_chong_count"] == 1

    r = detect_relations(PILLARS_1990)
    s = summarize_relations(r)
    assert s["has_he"] is True
    assert s["day_he"] is True
    assert s["has_hyeong"] is True         # 자형
    assert s["has_gan_he"] is False

    r = detect_relations(PILLARS_GAN_HE)
    s = summarize_relations(r)
    assert s["has_gan_he"] is True
    assert s["gan_he_count"] == 1

# tests/test_sinsal.py
from app.engine.sinsal import detect_sinsal, summarize_sinsal, _samhap_group


# 1974-02-24 05:30 KST: 甲寅 丙寅 丙申 庚寅
# 년지 寅 → 삼합 寅午戌(火)
#   도화(卯): 없음
#   역마(申): 일지 申 ✅
#   화개(戌): 없음
# 일간 丙 → 천을귀인: 亥, 酉 (없음)
#        → 문창귀인: 申 (일지에 있음 ✅)
#        → 양인: 午 (없음)
# 일주 丙申 → 괴강 아님
PILLARS_1974 = {
    "year_pillar": "甲寅",
    "month_pillar": "丙寅",
    "day_pillar": "丙申",
    "hour_pillar": "庚寅",
}

# 1990-05-05 14:30: 庚午 庚辰 庚午 癸未
# 년지 午 → 삼합 寅午戌(火)
#   도화(卯): 없음
#   역마(申): 없음
#   화개(戌): 없음
# 일간 庚 → 천을귀인: 丑, 未 → 시지 未 ✅
#        → 문창귀인: 亥 (없음)
#        → 양인: 酉 (없음)
PILLARS_1990 = {
    "year_pillar": "庚午",
    "month_pillar": "庚辰",
    "day_pillar": "庚午",
    "hour_pillar": "癸未",
}

# 도화 검출용: 년지 申 → 삼합 申子辰(水), 도화=酉
PILLARS_DOHWA = {
    "year_pillar": "甲申",
    "month_pillar": "乙酉",   # 도화!
    "day_pillar": "戊午",
    "hour_pillar": "庚申",
}

# 괴강 검출용: 일주 庚辰
PILLARS_GOEGANG = {
    "year_pillar": "甲子",
    "month_pillar": "丙寅",
    "day_pillar": "庚辰",   # 괴강!
    "hour_pillar": "庚午",
}


def test_samhap_group():
    assert _samhap_group("寅") == "寅午戌"
    assert _samhap_group("申") == "申子辰"
    assert _samhap_group("酉") == "巳酉丑"
    assert _samhap_group("亥") == "亥卯未"
    assert _samhap_group("") == ""


def test_yeokma_1974():
    """1974: 년지 寅 → 역마 申 → 일지에 있음."""
    s = detect_sinsal(PILLARS_1974)
    yeokmas = s["역마"]
    assert len(yeokmas) == 1
    assert yeokmas[0]["position"] == "day_pillar"
    assert yeokmas[0]["branch"] == "申"


def test_munchang_1974():
    """1974: 일간 丙 → 문창귀인 申 → 일지에 있음."""
    s = detect_sinsal(PILLARS_1974)
    munchangs = s["문창귀인"]
    assert len(munchangs) == 1
    assert munchangs[0]["branch"] == "申"


def test_cheoneul_1990():
    """1990: 일간 庚 → 천을귀인 丑,未 → 시지 未."""
    s = detect_sinsal(PILLARS_1990)
    cheoneuls = s["천을귀인"]
    assert len(cheoneuls) == 1
    assert cheoneuls[0]["position"] == "hour_pillar"
    assert cheoneuls[0]["branch"] == "未"


def test_dohwa_detection():
    """년지 申 → 도화 酉 → 월지에 있음."""
    s = detect_sinsal(PILLARS_DOHWA)
    dohwas = s["도화"]
    assert len(dohwas) == 1
    assert dohwas[0]["position"] == "month_pillar"
    assert dohwas[0]["branch"] == "酉"


def test_goegang_detection():
    """일주 庚辰 → 괴강."""
    s = detect_sinsal(PILLARS_GOEGANG)
    assert len(s["괴강"]) == 1
    assert s["괴강"][0]["position"] == "day_pillar"


def test_yangin_detection():
    """일간 丙 → 양인 午. 1990 케이스는 午가 년지/일지에 있음."""
    # 일간 甲 양인=卯 케이스
    pillars = {
        "year_pillar": "甲子",
        "month_pillar": "丁卯",   # 양인
        "day_pillar": "甲寅",
        "hour_pillar": "丙寅",
    }
    s = detect_sinsal(pillars)
    yangins = s["양인"]
    assert len(yangins) == 1
    assert yangins[0]["branch"] == "卯"


def test_summarize():
    """요약 플래그 및 카운트 검증."""
    s = detect_sinsal(PILLARS_1974)
    summ = summarize_sinsal(s)
    assert summ["has_yeokma"] is True
    assert summ["has_munchang"] is True
    assert summ["has_cheoneul"] is False
    assert summ["has_dohwa"] is False
    assert summ["count"] >= 2


def test_empty_safe():
    """비어있는 입력도 크래시 없이 빈 결과."""
    s = detect_sinsal({})
    assert s["도화"] == []
    assert s["역마"] == []
    assert s["괴강"] == []

from app.engine.calculator import calculate_saju


def test_sohan_boundary_丑월_transition():
    """소한(1/5~1/6) 직전·직후로 子월 → 丑월 전환 검증."""
    # 1990-01-05 소한 무렵. 정확 시각은 매년 달라지나 1/5~1/6 사이.
    before = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1990-01-05", birth_time="00:00:00",
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul", longitude=126.9780, correction_mode="none",
    )
    after = calculate_saju(
        birth_date="1990-01-10", birth_time="00:00:00",
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul", longitude=126.9780, correction_mode="none",
    )
    # 1/5 입춘 전이므로 solar_year = 1989
    assert before["solar_year"] == 1989
    assert after["solar_year"] == 1989
    # 1/10은 소한 이후 → 丑월
    assert after["month_pillar"][1] == "丑"

def test_compat_new_relationship_types(fresh_auth):
    a = client.post("/api/v1/auth/anonymous").json()
    from app.auth.repository import get_repository
    get_repository().grant_addon(a["user"]["id"], "compatibility")
    
    pair = {
        "person_a": BASE_PAYLOAD,
        "person_b": BASE_PAYLOAD,
        "lang": "ko",

    for rel_type in ("friend", "family"):
        resp = client.post(

        )
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"relationship_type={rel_type} failed"
        body = resp.json()["compatibility"]
        assert body["meta"]["relationship_type"] == rel_type
        assert body["relationship_advice"] != ""

# tests/test_strength.py
from app.engine.elements import analyze_element_distribution
from app.engine.strength import assess_day_master_strength


# 1974-02-24 05:30 KST (庚寅시) — 甲寅 丙寅 丙申 庚寅
PILLARS_1974 = {
    "year_pillar": "甲寅",
    "month_pillar": "丙寅",
    "day_pillar": "丙申",
    "hour_pillar": "庚寅",
}


def test_element_distribution_1974():
    """목(木) 과다, 甲·寅이 압도적. 화(火)는 丙 2개."""
    dist = analyze_element_distribution(PILLARS_1974)
    counts = dist["counts"]

    # 木: 년간 甲(1.0) + 월지寅 정기 甲(1.0) + 일지X + 시지寅 정기 甲(1.0)
    #    + 년지寅 정기 甲(1.0) + 지장간 중기들(丙戊)
    # 대략 4~5점 예상
    assert counts["木"] >= 4.0
    assert "木" in dist["dominant"]
    assert dist["counts"]["水"] < 1.0  # 물 기운 거의 없음


def test_day_master_strength_1974_strong():
    """丙 일간에 甲(인성)·丙(비견)·寅(인성) 다수 → 신강."""
