=== FILE: tests/test_time_correction.py ===
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from app.engine.time_correction import calculate_adjusted_times


def test_lmt_exact_seoul():
    """서울 1990-05-05 14:30 KST의 LMT 및 UTC 값 검증."""
    utc_dt, adjusted = calculate_adjusted_times(
        birth_date="1990-05-05",
        birth_time="14:30:00",
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="lmt",
    )
    # KST(UTC+9) → UTC 05:30
    assert utc_dt == datetime(1990, 5, 5, 5, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    # LMT = UTC + 126.9780/15h = 05:30 + 8h27m54.72s = 13:57:54.72
    assert adjusted == datetime(1990, 5, 5, 13, 57, 54, 720000)


def test_calculate_adjusted_times_none():
    """correction_mode='none'이면 보정 없이 벽시계 그대로."""
    utc_dt, adjusted = calculate_adjusted_times(
        birth_date="1990-05-05",
        birth_time="14:30:00",
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="none",
    )
    assert adjusted == datetime(1990, 5, 5, 14, 30, 0)
    assert utc_dt == datetime(1990, 5, 5, 5, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def test_lmt_negative_longitude():
    """서부 경도(뉴욕 -74)에서는 LMT가 벽시계보다 느려야 함."""
    utc_dt, adjusted = calculate_adjusted_times(
        birth_date="2000-07-04",
        birth_time="12:00:00",
        timezone_str="America/New_York",
        longitude=-74.0060,
        correction_mode="lmt",
    )
    # 2000-07-04 EDT (UTC-4) → UTC 16:00
    assert utc_dt == datetime(2000, 7, 4, 16, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    # LMT = 16:00 + (-74.0060/15)h = 16:00 - 4h56m1.44s = 11:03:58.56
    assert adjusted == datetime(2000, 7, 4, 11, 3, 58, 560000)


def test_dst_lmt_seoul_1988():
    """서울 서머타임 기간(1988-05-08) LMT 검증."""
    utc_dt, adjusted = calculate_adjusted_times(
        birth_date="1988-05-08",
        birth_time="12:00:00",
        timezone_str="Asia/Seoul",
        longitude=126.9780,
        correction_mode="lmt",
    )
    # 1988-05-08 KST는 DST 시행 중 (UTC+10) → UTC 02:00
    assert utc_dt == datetime(1988, 5, 8, 2, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    # LMT = 02:00 + 8h27m54.72s = 10:27:54.72
    assert adjusted == datetime(1988, 5, 8, 10, 27, 54, 720000)

=== FILE: tests/test_variation.py ===
"""variation 엔진 테스트."""
import pytest

from app.services.variation import pick_variant, make_seed, _stable_hash


def test_pick_variant_deterministic():
    v = ["a", "b", "c"]
    seed = ("user-1", "daily", "2026-10-18")
    r1 = pick_variant(v, seed_parts=seed)
    r2 = pick_variant(v, seed_parts=seed)
    assert r1 == r2


def test_pick_variant_across_processes():
    """_stable_hash는 sha256 기반 → 프로세스 재시작에도 동일."""
    v = ["x", "y", "z"]
    seed = ("u", "daily", "2026-10-18")
    # 여러 번 호출해도 같은 값
    results = {pick_variant(v, seed_parts=seed) for _ in range(10)}
    assert len(results) == 1


def test_pick_variant_different_seeds_may_differ():
    """다른 시드는 반드시 달라야 하는 건 아니지만, 통계적으로 분포한다."""
    v = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]
    picks = {
        pick_variant(v, seed_parts=("user", "daily", f"2026-01-{i:02d}"))
        for i in range(1, 32)
    }
    assert len(picks) >= 3  # 5 variants 중 최소 3개는 등장해야 함


def test_pick_variant_single_element():
    assert pick_variant(["only"], seed_parts=("x",)) == "only"


def test_pick_variant_empty_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="must not be empty"):
        pick_variant([], seed_parts=("x",))


def test_stable_hash_deterministic():
    h1 = _stable_hash("user", "daily", "2026-10-18")
    h2 = _stable_hash("user", "daily", "2026-10-18")
    assert h1 == h2
    assert isinstance(h1, int)
    assert h1 > 0


def test_make_seed_priority():
    # user_id 우선
    s1 = make_seed(user_id="U", birth_date="B", scope="daily", discriminator="D")
    assert s1[0] == "U"

    # birth_date fallback
    s2 = make_seed(user_id=None, birth_date="B", scope="daily", discriminator="D")
    assert s2[0] == "B"

    # anonymous fallback
    s3 = make_seed(user_id=None, birth_date=None, scope="daily", discriminator="D")
    assert s3[0] == "anonymous"


def test_make_seed_shape():
    s = make_seed(user_id="U", birth_date=None, scope="daily", discriminator="2026-10-18")
    assert len(s) == 3
    assert s[1] == "daily"
    assert s[2] == "2026-10-18"

"""3D 아트워크 매핑 파이프라인 테스트."""
from app.engine.calculator import calculate_saju
from app.semantic.tagger import build_semantic_profile
from app.services.visual_generator import get_daily_wallpaper_url
from app.services.content_writer import generate_full_report


def _profile(birth_date="1974-02-24", birth_time="05:30:00"):
    result = calculate_saju(
        birth_date=birth_date, birth_time=birth_time,
        birth_location="seoul", correction_mode="lmt", jasi_boundary=23, gender="M",
    )
    return build_semantic_profile(result)


def test_wallpaper_url_mapping():
    """오행과 십성에 따라 올바른 파일명이 생성되어야 함."""
    # 1974 케이스: 목(GROWTH) + 탐구자(THE_MYSTIC)
    profile = _profile()
    url = get_daily_wallpaper_url(profile)
    assert "bg_wood_generalist.webp" in url
    
    # 1990 케이스: 금(EDGE) + (work_mode에 따라 다름)
    profile_1990 = _profile("1990-05-05", "14:30:00")
    url_1990 = get_daily_wallpaper_url(profile_1990)
    assert "bg_metal_generalist.webp" in url_1990


def test_report_contains_wallpaper_url():
    """리포트 meta 데이터에 wallpaper_url이 포함되어야 함."""
    profile = _profile()
    report = generate_full_report(profile, lang="en")
    
    assert "daily_wallpaper_url" in report["meta"]
    assert report["meta"]["daily_wallpaper_url"].endswith(".webp")
    assert "mock-cdn.vectorlabs.app" in report["meta"]["daily_wallpaper_url"]

# tests/test_yongsin.py
from app.engine.yongsin import derive_useful_god, _role_elements


# 1974-02-24 05:30 KST: 甲寅 丙寅 丙申 庚寅
PILLARS_1974 = {
    "year_pillar": "甲寅",
    "month_pillar": "丙寅",
    "day_pillar": "丙申",
    "hour_pillar": "庚寅",
}

# 丙 일간이 水(관성)로 둘러싸인 신약 케이스
PILLARS_WEAK = {
    "year_pillar": "壬子",
    "month_pillar": "壬子",
    "day_pillar": "丙午",
    "hour_pillar": "癸亥",
}


def test_role_elements_fire_day_master():
    """일간 火 기준 역할→오행 매핑."""
    roles = _role_elements("火")
    assert roles["비겁"] == "火"
    assert roles["인성"] == "木"
    assert roles["식상"] == "土"
    assert roles["재성"] == "金"
    assert roles["관성"] == "水"


def test_role_elements_wood_day_master():
    """일간 木 기준."""
    roles = _role_elements("木")
    assert roles["비겁"] == "木"
    assert roles["인성"] == "水"
    assert roles["식상"] == "火"
    assert roles["재성"] == "土"
    assert roles["관성"] == "金"


def test_yongsin_1974_strong_uses_output():
    """신강 1974 케이스 → 식상(土) 용신, 재성(金) 희신."""
    result = derive_useful_god(PILLARS_1974)
    assert result["strength"]["verdict"] == "신강"
    assert result["yongsin"] == "土"
    assert result["yongsin_role"] == "식상"
    assert result["huisin"] == "金"
    assert result["huisin_role"] == "재성"
    assert "木" in result["gisin"]   # 인성
    assert "火" in result["gisin"]   # 비겁


def test_yongsin_weak_uses_resource():
    """신약 케이스 → 인성(木) 용신, 비겁(火) 희신."""
    result = derive_useful_god(PILLARS_WEAK)
    assert result["strength"]["verdict"] == "신약"
    assert result["yongsin"] == "木"
    assert result["yongsin_role"] == "인성"
    assert result["huisin"] == "火"
    assert result["huisin_role"] == "비겁"


def test_yongsin_gisin_are_opposite_of_favorable():
    """기신은 용신·희신과 겹치지 않아야 함."""
    for pillars in (PILLARS_1974, PILLARS_WEAK):
        result = derive_useful_god(pillars)
        favorable = {result["yongsin"], result["huisin"]}
        for g in result["gisin"]:
            assert g not in favorable


def test_yongsin_reason_nonempty():
    """reason이 문자열이며 판정 근거를 담고 있어야 함."""
    for pillars in (PILLARS_1974, PILLARS_WEAK):
        result = derive_useful_god(pillars)
        assert isinstance(result["reason"], str)
        assert len(result["reason"]) > 0
        assert result["strength"]["verdict"] in result["reason"]
